name: Bulbasaur
description: A seed rides on its back from birth, drawing strength from sunlight. Even its naps help the plant grow.

name: Ivysaur
description: As the bud grows heavier, Ivysaur’s legs strengthen to bear it. A sweet scent hints that blooming time is near.

name: Venusaur
description: Venusaur’s flower releases a sweet, bewitching fragrance. Those in the middle of a battle find themselves growing calm.

name: Charmander
description: From the time it’s born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Charizard
description: Boulders can melt beneath Charizard’s fiery breath. It seeks worthy rivals, but spares foes it considers weaker.

name: Squirtle
description: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
description: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
description: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Caterpie
description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
description: Like a locked room around a delicate secret, Metapod’s shell guards its soft insides. It hardens the casing and waits to evolve.

name: Butterfree
description: A distant patch of blooming flowers is no trouble for Butterfree to find. It carries honey home, even through heavy rain.

name: Weedle
description: A tiny horn sits on Weedle’s head, ready to defend it. Its sharp sense of smell helps it choose favorite leaves.

name: Kakuna
description: Kakuna is in between forms, hardening its shell while its body changes inside. It’s almost completely unable to move.

name: Beedrill
description: Three poisonous stingers make Beedrill a dangerous neighbor. Anger one near its nest, and a whole swarm may follow.

name: Pidgey
description: Pidgey is a docile bird that avoids fights. When it’s attacked, it kicks up sand with its wings to throw off the attacker.

name: Pidgeotto
description: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

name: Pidgeot
description: Pidgeot flies at incredible speed while hunting. Its sharp talons make it a fearsome predator.

name: Rattata
description: Rattata chews through almost anything with its sharp fangs. It breeds quickly, and a single sighting often means a whole colony is close by.

name: Raticate
description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Spearow
description: Spearow’s harsh cry carries a long way. Despite its small wings, it beats them rapidly to stay aloft.

name: Fearow
description: This long-billed Pokémon defends its territory fiercely, and it uses its great speed to escape from danger in an instant.

name: Ekans
description: Ekans glides silently through grass, tracking prey by scent. At night, it coils around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
description: Arbok holds a grudge. Once it has chosen its prey, it will track the target across any distance until the chase is over.

name: Pikachu
description: Pikachu stores electricity in its cheeks and may spark when startled. A raised tail helps it watch for danger.

name: Raichu
description: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

name: Sandshrew
description: Sandshrew rolls into a ball to protect its soft underside. Dry ground suits it best, since moisture makes its skin uncomfortable.

name: Sandslash
description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Nidoran♀
description: Nidoran♀ is small and mild-mannered, but it isn’t helpless. Its little horn holds a potent poison that makes even a minor scratch dangerous.

name: Nidorina
description: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

name: Nidoqueen
description: Nidoqueen’s thick hide shields it from many attacks. It can send foes flying with a powerful swing of its tail.

name: Nidoran♂
description: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it befriends.

name: Nidorino
description: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

name: Nidoking
description: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

name: Clefairy
description: Moonlight often draws Clefairy out to dance in a ring. The sight is so rare that a glimpse is considered lucky.

name: Clefable
description: Clefable is a timid fairy Pokémon that’s rarely seen. It runs and hides the moment it senses people nearby.

name: Vulpix
description: Vulpix grows from one tail to six curled ones. It can aim its fiery breath with remarkable precision.

name: Ninetales
description: Its bright red eyes and flickering flames leave opponents hypnotized. Only then does this clever Pokémon attack.

name: Jigglypuff
description: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

name: Wigglytuff
description: With each deep breath, Wigglytuff expands like a balloon. Its plush fur is prized for being exceptionally soft.

name: Zubat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
description: Night gives Golbat cover for a silent approach. Its hollow fangs draw blood like a pair of tiny straws.

name: Oddish
description: A clump of leaves may be Oddish hiding in the soil. It emerges after dark and wanders beneath the moon.

name: Gloom
description: Gloom drools honey that stinks so badly it can knock opponents out. A few people, oddly enough, find the smell appealing.

name: Vileplume
description: Vileplume’s enormous flower is beautiful but dangerous. Its petals release clouds of potent, toxic pollen.

name: Paras
description: Paras lives in humid forests near the base of trees. The mushrooms on its back, called tochukaso, grow larger as it matures.

name: Parasect
description: Parasect is an uneasy pair: a weakened insect and a commanding mushroom. The fungus seems to do the thinking for both.

name: Venonat
description: Its large red eyes are made of many tiny eyes, and they work like radar, letting it see well in the dark.

name: Venomoth
description: Venomoth’s wings shed stubborn, poisonous scales. Even brief contact can leave a toxic trace on skin.

name: Diglett
description: Diglett stays underground but leaves a visible trail. Soil bulges wherever its tunnels pass below.

name: Dugtrio
description: Dugtrio’s heads are sleek and smooth and incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with its headbutts.

name: Meowth
description: Meowth rests by day and prowls after dark. Loose coins and shiny trinkets are irresistible additions to its stash.

name: Persian
description: This Pokémon is popular with rich people. It’s also targeted by hunters who are after the jewel in its forehead.

name: Psyduck
description: As Psyduck gets stressed out, its headache gets progressively worse. It uses intense psychic energy to overwhelm those around it.

name: Golduck
description: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

name: Mankey
description: This agile monkey leaps from branch to branch. Once something makes it angry, it attacks without a second thought.

name: Primeape
description: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around, so that calm moment is very hard to witness.

name: Growlithe
description: Growlithe has a keen sense of smell and remembers every scent. It bravely barks at strangers while staying loyal to familiar faces.

name: Arcanine
description: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.

name: Poliwag
description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like suction cups.

name: Poliwhirl
description: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

name: Poliwrath
description: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

name: Abra
description: Sleep takes up most of Abra’s day, often 18 hours of it. Even asleep, it can teleport away from danger.

name: Kadabra
description: Kadabra’s psychic energy has unsettling side effects, from headaches to clocks running backward. Danger only sharpens its power.

name: Alakazam
description: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It’s said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

name: Machop
description: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

name: Machoke
description: Machoke wears a belt that helps regulate its immense strength. Without it, the power in its muscles can become hard to control.

name: Machamp
description: Four muscular arms let Machamp attack and defend at once. It can land over a thousand blows in an instant.

name: Bellsprout
description: Bellsprout’s thin body bends like a vine in the wind. Its roots absorb moisture, letting it survive on very little water.

name: Weepinbell
description: A sweet scent can lure prey toward Weepinbell’s open mouth. Once caught, the meal is dissolved by its potent digestive juices.

name: Victreebel
description: Victreebel keeps a sweet, honey-scented fluid in its mouth. The fluid is actually a powerful acid that dissolves anything.

name: Tentacool
description: Tentacool drift in shallow seas and fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs on their heads that resemble eyes. At low tide, some are found on beaches, dried out.

name: Tentacruel
description: Tentacruel spreads its many tentacles to catch prey. The red orbs on its head glow when it unleashes psychic energy.

name: Geodude
description: Geodude blends into rocky ground until a toughness contest begins. Rivals slam together to test their hardness.

name: Graveler
description: Graveler rolls recklessly down cliffs. If it tumbles into a river, it may erupt in a violent explosion.

name: Golem
description: Golem’s shell is harder than diamond and can withstand explosions. Once a year, it sheds that shell and grows a new one.

name: Ponyta
description: Ponyta foals start life without the flames that define them. Their fiery manes develop roughly an hour after birth.

name: Rapidash
description: Rapidash loves to race and can reach tremendous speeds. Its fiery mane streams behind it as it gallops.

name: Slowpoke
description: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

name: Slowbro
description: When Shellder bites Slowbro’s tail, the two form an unusual pair. The bite dulls its senses but can spark surprising ideas.

name: Magnemite
description: It subsists on electricity. As Magnemite flies, it emits electromagnetic waves from the units on each side of its body.

name: Magneton
description: This Pokémon is constantly putting out a powerful magnetic force. Most computers go haywire when a Magneton approaches.

name: Farfetch’d
description: This Pokémon never goes far without its trusty plant stalk. It uses the stalk to fight off foes and skillfully arrange its nest.

name: Doduo
description: Doduo makes up for its poor flying with remarkable speed. Its two heads help it balance while running.

name: Dodrio
description: Dodrio’s three heads express three different emotions: joy, sadness, and anger. It’s a rare sight, and it runs at great speed on its strong legs.

name: Seel
description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don’t bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
description: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

name: Grimer
description: Born from pollution, Grimer leaves a stench wherever it slides. Even hardy plants struggle to grow in its trail.

name: Muk
description: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

name: Shellder
description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It’s vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
description: Once it slams its shell shut, it’s impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Gastly
description: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, Gastly can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Haunter
description: Haunter lurks in darkness and glides through walls. A lick from its gaseous tongue causes endless shaking.

name: Gengar
description: It lurks in the shadows and steals warmth from anything nearby. A sudden chill in a room is often blamed on its presence.

name: Onix
description: Onix burrows through the earth by twisting its massive body. The rocks that form its body harden as it grows older.

name: Drowzee
description: Drowzee feeds on dreams, putting sleeping people in a trance and drawing their dreams out with its long snout.

name: Hypno
description: Hypno is highly skilled at hypnosis, and its pendulum can lull even a determined foe into a deep sleep within moments.

name: Krabby
description: Krabby’s bubble cloak is a bluff meant to make danger think twice. Beneath it, sturdy claws stand ready to pinch or defend.

name: Kingler
description: Kingler’s oversized claw can crush with ease. Its lopsided build makes ordinary movement awkward.

name: Voltorb
description: Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it rolls around cheerfully until it gets excited and releases a burst of electricity.

name: Electrode
description: Electrode stores electrical energy beneath its smooth shell. A sudden jolt can make it explode without warning.

name: Exeggcute
description: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

name: Exeggutor
description: When its three heads work together, Exeggutor can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Cubone
description: Grief gave Cubone its most recognizable armor: its mother’s skull. The skull is a reminder of its sorrow.

name: Marowak
description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Its legs freely contract and stretch, allowing it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
description: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete, but Hitmonchan needs a rest after three minutes of fighting.

name: Lickitung
description: Lickitung investigates the world with its long tongue. Its saliva is sticky.

name: Koffing
description: A foul cloud hangs around Koffing. Its vents release fumes when threatened.

name: Weezing
description: This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Rhyhorn charges first and thinks later. Its thick hide takes the punishment.

name: Rhydon
description: A drill-like horn crowns Rhydon’s armored head. Few barriers withstand a full charge.

name: Chansey
description: Chansey produces a few eggs every day. They’re so nutritious and tasty that even people with no appetite will eagerly gobble them up.

name: Tangela
description: It keeps the blue vines covering its body wriggling and shaking to unnerve its opponents. Anything caught in them finds the movement ticklish.

name: Kangaskhan
description: Kangaskhan will endure terrible injuries rather than abandon its young. It even sleeps standing up to keep the baby safe.

name: Horsea
description: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Seadra
description: Seaweed forests suit Seadra, whose spines deter intruders. Males guard the eggs with unusual care.

name: Goldeen
description: Its flowing tail makes Goldeen look like a living jewel. That pointed horn is ready when danger nears.

name: Seaking
description: Seaking swims upstream to reach its nest. Its horn can pierce rocks and hard riverbeds.

name: Staryu
description: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Starmie
description: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

name: Mr. Mime
description: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

name: Scyther
description: Scyther cuts through thick vegetation with its forearm blades. Its speed makes it a fearsome ambush hunter.

name: Jynx
description: Jynx sways to a rhythm only it seems to hear. Its voice has a strange, lilting cadence.

name: Electabuzz
description: Power lines draw Electabuzz like a beacon. Sparks crackle across its body when excited.

name: Magmar
description: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out.

name: Pinsir
description: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

name: Tauros
description: Tauros is a rowdy Pokémon with energy to spare. Once it breaks into a run, nothing short of a collision will slow it down.

name: Magikarp
description: Many dismiss Magikarp for its weak splashes. Its persistence outlasts the mockery.

name: Gyarados
description: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

name: Lapras
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Ditto
description: Ditto copies almost anything, but memory can betray a disguise. A tiny detail may come out wrong when it transforms.

name: Eevee
description: A rare Pokémon, Eevee can adapt to harsh surroundings by taking on a different evolved form. There are eight possibilities in all.

name: Vaporeon
description: Vaporeon can blend into waves near the shore. Its cells resemble water itself.

name: Jolteon
description: Its fur stands on end, becoming like needles it fires at enemies. Once they’re weakened, it finishes them off with a 10,000-volt shock.

name: Flareon
description: Heat builds inside Flareon’s fluffy collar. Its soft coat hides a fiery core.

name: Porygon
description: Porygon is an artificial Pokémon made from computer code. It patrols cyberspace, checking for suspicious data.

name: Omanyte
description: Omanyte is an ancient sea Pokémon restored from fossils. It paddles with ten tentacles and hides in its shell when threatened.

name: Omastar
description: Omastar reaches out with a cluster of grasping tentacles. A strong beak finishes the meal.

name: Kabuto
description: This ancient Pokémon hasn’t changed in 300 million years. It’s usually revived from fossils, but a few living ones have been found.

name: Kabutops
description: Kabutops swims fast with its sickle arms folded close. Its claws seize prey and drain its fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
description: High above the ground, a shrill cry announces Aerodactyl’s arrival. Its jagged teeth can tear prey apart.

name: Snorlax
description: This gluttonous Pokémon shows up in villages without warning and eats every bit of their stored rice. Such visits have long been counted among the worst disasters.

name: Articuno
description: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. It’s said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

name: Zapdos
description: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Moltres
description: Embers spill from Moltres with every wingbeat, turning flight into a blaze. Legends say its arrival ends winter and brings warmth to the land.

name: Dratini
description: Hardly anyone has laid eyes on Dratini, which is why it’s nicknamed the Mirage Pokémon. All that people occasionally find are its cast-off skins.

name: Dragonair
description: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

name: Dragonite
description: Dragonite is kindhearted and can’t ignore anyone in trouble. It rescues drowning swimmers and guides ships through storms to land.

name: Mewtwo
description: Humans gave Mewtwo a powerful body but no warm heart. All it thinks about is defeating its opponents.

name: Mew
description: Hidden from most eyes, Mew carries genes said to encompass every Pokémon. Its ability to vanish makes sightings rare.

name: Chikorita
description: Chikorita tests the air with the leaf on its head. Its fragrance is soothing and sweet.

name: Bayleef
description: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

name: Meganium
description: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off even more of its calming scent to dull the foe’s fighting spirit.

name: Cyndaquil
description: When danger appears, Cyndaquil can ignite its back. Its timid nature keeps the sparks hidden.

name: Quilava
description: A line of fire crowns Quilava’s head and back. It darts around foes before they react.

name: Typhlosion
description: When Typhlosion’s anger peaks, its heat becomes dangerous to touch. Anything that brushes its burning body may burst into flame.

name: Totodile
description: This rowdy little crocodile Pokémon chomps on anything that moves, and a bite from its jaws is no joke.

name: Croconaw
description: Croconaw’s mouth always holds exactly 48 fangs. Lose one in a fight and a replacement soon pushes through.

name: Feraligatr
description: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at incredible speed.

name: Sentret
description: Sentret rises on its tail to scan for danger. A sharp cry and a thump on the ground alert the whole group.

name: Furret
description: Furret threads its long body through impossibly small gaps. Catching up is another matter entirely.

name: Hoothoot
description: Each day, Hoothoot calls at the same hour. A long time ago, people cherished it and considered it a divine messenger sent to tell the time.

name: Noctowl
description: Noctowl sees by gathering even faint light. When puzzled, it swivels its head almost all the way around.

name: Ledyba
description: Cold weather draws Ledyba into warm clusters. Their scented secretions also let them communicate without a sound.

name: Ledian
description: Ledian is most active on clear nights, when it flies by starlight and sprinkles glittering dust behind it. Some people say the dust brings good fortune.

name: Spinarak
description: Spinarak waits motionless until prey wanders close. Fine threads turn its web into a sensitive alarm.

name: Ariados
description: Ariados leaves silk trails as it roams at night. Its prey may never see the trap.

name: Crobat
description: Its hind limbs have become a second set of wings. Crobat flies skillfully on all four, darting through even the tightest caves without losing speed.

name: Chinchou
description: Two glowing antennae light Chinchou’s way through the deep. Their opposing electrical charges can stun prey in a flash.

name: Lanturn
description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Pichu
description: When two Pichu touch tails, sparks fly, and the surprise often leaves one of them in tears. It may be a game of dare.

name: Cleffa
description: In silhouette, Cleffa resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, they gather in numbers and dance as if they were stars come to life.

name: Igglybuff
description: Igglybuff’s elastic body rebounds like a rubber ball. Its sweet song can leave it hoarse.

name: Togepi
description: This egg-shaped Pokémon is often mistaken for a moving egg when it turns up in fields or mountains. Its innocent smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
description: A symbol of good fortune, Togetic is believed to bring luck to people with pure hearts. No record exists of it living in the wild.

name: Natu
description: Natu climbs tree trunks with surprising skill and loves to peck at fresh shoots. It can even pull food from a cactus without touching the spines.

name: Xatu
description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

name: Mareep
description: This sheep-like Pokémon lights up the tip of its tail when electricity gathers in its body. Its wool is soft, but it carries a shocking surprise.

name: Flaaffy
description: Flaaffy’s wool can hold a powerful electrical charge. Its tail orb lights up with stored power.

name: Ampharos
description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Bellossom
description: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Marill
description: The ball on the end of Marill’s tail is packed with oil that floats on water. It works like a life preserver and keeps Marill afloat in a strong current.

name: Azumarill
description: Azumarill’s bubble-like markings hide its outline underwater. It can also blow air bubbles to help a drowning Pokémon breathe.

name: Sudowoodo
description: A tree that stays green through winter may be Sudowoodo in disguise. For all its leafy act, its body is closer to stone.

name: Politoed
description: One resonant call from Politoed can bring nearby tadpoles flocking over. Its curled head tuft signals rank among its kind.

name: Hoppip
description: Hoppip loves a gentle breeze, but a gust can send it tumbling away. Its kind cling together when the weather turns rough.

name: Skiploom
description: Skiploom’s flower is a living thermometer, opening wider as the air warms. Rain makes it close up and seek shelter beneath leaves.

name: Jumpluff
description: Jumpluff rides the wind with its cotton spores. It can travel great distances without effort.

name: Aipom
description: It uses its hand-like tail to pluck fruit that’s out of reach. The tail has become so handy that its actual hands are rather clumsy.

name: Sunkern
description: Small and seed-like, Sunkern relies on sunlight to get by. Even a modest breeze can toss it away.

name: Sunflora
description: Sunflora spreads golden petals like rays of sunshine. Nightfall brings calm until morning.

name: Yanma
description: Yanma can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It’s a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.

name: Wooper
description: A slick, poisonous coating protects Wooper while it walks on land. It usually lives in cold water but ventures out to find food.

name: Quagsire
description: Quagsire doesn’t chase food. It floats in the water with its jaws hanging open and lets unwary prey swim right in.

name: Espeon
description: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.

name: Umbreon
description: It’s most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

name: Murkrow
description: Murkrow hides shiny treasures in secret stashes. Its nighttime appearance has earned it a reputation for bringing bad luck.

name: Slowking
description: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing it says.

name: Misdreavus
description: Misdreavus enjoys frightening people by tugging hair or making strange sounds. The fear it causes seems to nourish it.

name: Unown
description: Like a letter from a forgotten alphabet, Unown clings to walls. Its strange shape may hold a meaning no one knows.

name: Wobbuffet
description: Wobbuffet avoids bright places and keeps its dark tail carefully hidden. It usually waits quietly rather than starting a fight.

name: Girafarig
description: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.

name: Pineco
description: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

name: Forretress
description: Forretress stays inside a tough steel shell that hides nearly all of its body. It can fire pieces of that shell when danger approaches.

name: Dunsparce
description: Dunsparce digs backward with its drill-like tail to escape danger. Far underground, it builds winding tunnels that form a maze around its nest.

name: Gligar
description: Gligar glides from cliffs with its arms spread wide. Its expression rarely gives warning.

name: Steelix
description: A strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Its body is coated with steel powder and is so hard that not even diamond can scratch it.

name: Snubbull
description: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
description: Those oversized fangs look fearsome, yet Granbull startles easily. Its intimidating face hides a timid heart.

name: Qwilfish
description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Scizor
description: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets ahold of into bits.

name: Shuckle
description: Shuckle stores berries inside its hard shell. The fruit slowly breaks down into a thick juice.

name: Heracross
description: Its horn is unparalleled, and so is its power. Heracross can throw several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Sneasel
description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for climbing steep cliffs. Venom drips from their tips and seeps into the nerves of any prey caught in its grasp.

name: Teddiursa
description: Teddiursa is fond of honey and often licks its paws to enjoy the sweetness. Its crescent-shaped mark glows whenever it finds some.

name: Ursaring
description: Ursaring settles in forests with many streams and towering trees, where food is plentiful. Every day, it walks its forest gathering something to eat.

name: Slugma
description: Slugma doesn’t have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

name: Magcargo
description: Magcargo carries a shell formed from cooled lava. Nearby ground can crack and dry from its heat.

name: Swinub
description: Swinub uses its sensitive nose to find food beneath grass, ice, or snow. While digging for mushrooms, it may unexpectedly uncover a hot spring.

name: Piloswine
description: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, letting Piloswine withstand bitter cold. Its white tusks can be used to fend off enemies.

name: Corsola
description: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

name: Remoraid
description: Remoraid shoots streams of water with marksman-like accuracy. Its quick swimming makes retaliation difficult.

name: Octillery
description: Octillery grabs foes with its suction-cup tentacles. It can blast water from its mouth to attack.

name: Delibird
description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

name: Mantine
description: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water.

name: Skarmory
description: Skarmory’s shed feathers are made into swords, and its image is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Houndour
description: Houndour hunt in coordinated packs, using special cries to keep track of one another. Their eerie calls can echo through the area before dawn.

name: Houndoom
description: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Kingdra
description: The scales Kingdra sheds shine so beautifully that people have presented them to royalty as gifts.

name: Phanpy
description: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water.

name: Donphan
description: Donphan’s tough hide shrugs off ordinary attacks. Its powerful tackle can knock down a house.

name: Porygon2
description: Artificial intelligence lets Porygon2 learn gestures and emotions on its own. Sometimes it makes movements that weren’t programmed.

name: Stantler
description: Stantler’s strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Smeargle
description: A tail-tip dab is Smeargle’s signature. Each one paints distinct marks in colored fluid to claim its territory.

name: Tyrogue
description: Though small, Tyrogue has a fierce competitive streak and challenges almost anyone. It often keeps fighting after larger opponents leave it bruised.

name: Hitmontop
description: Its dance-like kicks can mesmerize an opponent before landing a blow. When it spins fast enough, it can even drill into the ground.

name: Smoochum
description: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

name: Elekid
description: Elekid generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, the lively voices of children heard out in the wilderness are actually Elekid.

name: Magby
description: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

name: Miltank
description: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Blissey
description: This caring Pokémon is always on the lookout for the sick and injured. Its nourishing eggs are said to make people smile.

name: Raikou
description: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

name: Entei
description: Volcanoes are said to erupt wherever Entei roars. Its mane ripples like living flame.

name: Suicune
description: Suicune runs across water as though it were solid ground. Its presence seems to purify tainted water.

name: Larvitar
description: Larvitar feeds on soil before emerging from underground. Its small frame hides grit and appetite.

name: Pupitar
description: Pupitar compresses gas inside its body and blasts it outward to propel itself. Its shell can withstand collisions with steel.

name: Tyranitar
description: Ordinary attacks can’t easily harm Tyranitar, making it eager to test its power. When it rampages, rivers may be buried and maps changed.

name: Lugia
description: Lugia is said to calm violent storms and appear when the seas grow rough. It rests deep beneath the ocean to keep its power in check.

name: Ho-Oh
description: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they’re struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers.

name: Celebi
description: Celebi can travel through time and is said to appear in peaceful eras. Its presence is believed to promise a bright future.

name: Treecko
description: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics in any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

name: Grovyle
description: Leaves break up Grovyle’s outline among forest branches. Few can match its speed when it leaps from tree to tree.

name: Sceptile
description: Sceptile leaps swiftly through trees and strikes with sharp leaves on its arms. Seeds on its back help nourish and revive trees.

name: Torchic
description: Torchic keeps a flame burning inside its belly, and its fluffy down makes it warm and cozy to hold.

name: Combusken
description: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

name: Blaziken
description: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

name: Mudkip
description: The fin on Mudkip’s head acts like a radar in water. Its tail can stir powerful currents.

name: Marshtomp
description: Marshtomp moves easily through mud where others would sink. Its skin must stay moist to remain healthy.

name: Swampert
description: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

name: Poochyena
description: Raised hackles and bared fangs make Poochyena look fierce. It pursues tired prey, but retreats when the tables turn.

name: Mightyena
description: Mightyena chase down prey in packs of around ten, defeating foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Zigzagoon
description: Zigzagoon zigzags wherever curiosity leads. It often collects things left behind.

name: Linoone
description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths isn’t its strong suit.

name: Wurmple
description: Bright spikes make Wurmple look less appetizing to birds. It spends much of its time chewing leaves.

name: Silcoon
description: Silcoon wraps itself in silk and waits quietly to evolve. It drinks rainwater or dew that gathers on its cocoon.

name: Beautifly
description: Beautifly is colorful and elegant, but it’s also greedy. It chases Combee away from flowers so that it can keep the nectar for itself.

name: Cascoon
description: Thin but strong silk covers its body. People rate it above Silcoon’s silk for luster and texture, and they prize clothes woven from it.

name: Dustox
description: It scatters its fine dust all over when it’s attacked. It’s a nocturnal Pokémon.

name: Lotad
description: Lotad lives in clean ponds and carries small Pokémon on its broad leaf. If it goes too long without water, the leaf wilts.

name: Lombre
description: A quiet daytime sleeper becomes a riverbank rascal after sunset. Lombre delights in startling people from the water.

name: Ludicolo
description: Festive music stimulates Ludicolo’s cells and fills its muscles with energy. It dances to the rhythm and won’t fear tough opponents.

name: Seedot
description: When Seedot stays still, it resembles an ordinary nut. It enjoys startling Pokémon that come searching for food.

name: Nuzleaf
description: A leaf plucked from its head becomes a flute in Nuzleaf’s hands. Its eerie tune unsettles anyone lost in the woods.

name: Shiftry
description: Shiftry keeps to remote forests, where its enormous fans stir fierce winds. Legends say it can read an opponent’s mind.

name: Taillow
description: Though Taillow bravely challenges stronger foes, it dislikes the cold. When temperatures drop, it flies far away to find warmth.

name: Swellow
description: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

name: Wingull
description: Wingull skates through the sky on ocean breezes, hardly needing to flap. It also hides food and shiny finds in secret spots.

name: Pelipper
description: Pelipper skims the water and scoops up food with its huge bill. It can carry small Pokémon inside its spacious beak.

name: Ralts
description: Warm feelings can make Ralts’s body grow slightly warmer. Its sensitive horns detect emotions long before words are spoken.

name: Kirlia
description: Joy seems to set Kirlia dancing, while its mind works stranger wonders. It can warp the space around it into mirages.

name: Gardevoir
description: Gardevoir is devoted to the people it adores, and it will use all its psychic power to protect them, even at the risk of its own life.

name: Surskit
description: Tiny feet let Surskit glide over pond surfaces without sinking. A sweet syrup from its head can lure curious prey.

name: Masquerain
description: Four wings give Masquerain nimble control in the air. Its eye-patterned antennae look fierce, but moisture can ground it.

name: Shroomish
description: Shroomish feeds on damp compost in shady forests. When danger approaches, it sprays toxic spores that cause pain and can wilt plants.

name: Breloom
description: Breloom fights with quick, precise punches. It also uses the toxic spores on its tail to weaken opponents.

name: Slakoth
description: Stillness suits Slakoth so well that it barely moves all day. Its slow heartbeat makes activity seem exhausting.

name: Vigoroth
description: Where Slakoth dozes, Vigoroth paces and fidgets. Its boundless energy needs an outlet, or nearby objects may suffer.

name: Slaking
description: This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only rolls over and moves when there’s no more grass to eat.

name: Nincada
description: Nincada spends years beneath the soil, far from sunlight. Its sharp claws cut into tree roots to draw out moisture and nutrients.

name: Ninjask
description: This Pokémon is so quick that it’s said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Shedinja
description: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and doesn’t breathe.

name: Whismur
description: Whismur breathes through its ear canals, letting it cry without pausing. Its own shrieks may startle it into louder crying.

name: Loudred
description: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Exploud
description: Exploud uses whistle-like tones to share its feelings. A huge inhale through its body ports may precede a deafening blast.

name: Makuhita
description: Meals, naps, and punishing workouts fill Makuhita’s routine. When knocked down, this gutsy Pokémon rises ready to keep fighting.

name: Hariyama
description: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t always the strongest. Some small ones move nimbly and fight with real skill.

name: Azurill
description: Azurill’s tail holds nutrients it needs to grow. When angry, it swings the large ball to strike opponents much bigger than itself.

name: Nosepass
description: Iron scraps cling to Nosepass when it boosts its magnetism. The same force can pull dinner straight toward its rocky body.

name: Skitty
description: A twitch can send Skitty chasing, even after its own tail. After spinning in circles, the curious cat may grow dizzy.

name: Delcatty
description: Delcatty seeks clean, comfortable places to groom and sleep instead of keeping a nest. If disturbed, it avoids fighting and simply moves away.

name: Sableye
description: Sableye feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Mawile
description: Mawile’s sweet face is a clever disguise for the steel jaws behind its head. The surprise bite can crush even iron beams.

name: Aron
description: Aron’s body is protected by steel armor that it strengthens by eating iron ore. It may even devour railroad tracks to get the metal it needs.

name: Lairon
description: Lairon defend their territory by slamming into rivals. Their steel armor bears scratches and dents from these battles.

name: Aggron
description: Aggron protects its mountain home and repairs damage by planting trees. Its sharp horn can pierce thick iron sheets during battle.

name: Meditite
description: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day.

name: Medicham
description: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

name: Electrike
description: Dry air can set Electrike sparkling from nose to tail. Friction builds electricity in its coat and powers quick reactions.

name: Manectric
description: Lightning strikes are said to mark Manectric’s nesting places. When it fights, electricity swells into storm clouds above it.

name: Plusle
description: Telephone poles charge Plusle for its lively displays. It shakes out electric pom-poms to celebrate others’ efforts.

name: Minun
description: This cheerful Pokémon expresses its excitement by crackling with electricity. When someone nearby is in danger, it releases increasingly powerful sparks.

name: Volbeat
description: Volbeat flash their tails to communicate and draw patterns in the night sky. They love Illumise’s scent and leave ponds when the water gets dirty.

name: Illumise
description: Illumise guides glowing Volbeat as they draw patterns in the night sky. Its sweet fragrance attracts the swarm.

name: Roselia
description: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

name: Gulpin
description: Gulpin’s stomach fills most of its body, while its heart and brain are tiny. Its enzymes dissolve swallowed food and release foul gases.

name: Swalot
description: Swalot has no teeth and swallows its food whole. Its huge mouth can fit an automobile tire with room to spare.

name: Carvanha
description: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Sharpedo
description: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked, no exceptions.

name: Wailmer
description: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Wailord
description: A Wailord’s enormous body can make the sea erupt in a towering splash. Pods leap together to herd schools of prey.

name: Numel
description: The hump on Numel’s back is more furnace than fat. When its magma cools in wet weather, movement becomes painfully sluggish.

name: Camerupt
description: Bone forms the humps on Camerupt’s back, but molten magma fills them. Its eruptions grow especially fierce when its temper flares.

name: Torkoal
description: Coal fuels the fire inside Torkoal’s shell, and its strength fades as the fuel runs low. A threat brings a curtain of black smoke.

name: Spoink
description: Spoink bounces on its spring-like tail to keep its heart beating. The pearl on its head boosts its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
description: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it’s doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

name: Spinda
description: Every Spinda has a unique pattern of spots across its body. Its wobbly steps can confuse foes and throw off their aim.

name: Trapinch
description: Trapinch hides at the bottom of a conical sand pit, waiting for prey to fall in. Its oversized jaws are strong enough to crunch boulders.

name: Vibrava
description: Vibrava rubs its developing wings together to create powerful ultrasonic waves. The sounds can make its prey faint and cause headaches.

name: Flygon
description: The beating of Flygon’s wings creates a melody that resembles singing. It stirs up desert sand to hide itself inside swirling storms.

name: Cacnea
description: The more arid and harsh its environment, the prettier and more fragrant the flower Cacnea grows. It battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

name: Cacturne
description: This cactus Pokémon avoids the harsh daytime sun and becomes active after dark. It stalks travelers until the desert heat leaves them exhausted.

name: Swablu
description: With wings as soft and white as cotton clouds, Swablu looks harmless and airy. It loves cleanliness and carefully grooms its fluffy feathers.

name: Altaria
description: Altaria sings with a crystal-clear voice as it floats through the sky. If provoked, it answers with shrill cries and fierce attacks.

name: Zangoose
description: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

name: Seviper
description: Seviper’s sword-like tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon won’t give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

name: Lunatone
description: Lunatone is believed to have come from a meteorite that fell to the ground long ago. Its gaze can lull foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it’s strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Barboach
description: Its entire body is gooey. When pecked at by bird Pokémon, it slips and slides its way to freedom.

name: Whiscash
description: Mud at the swamp bottom hides Whiscash through the day. At night it feeds, and its thrashing can shake the ground like a quake.

name: Corphish
description: This hardy Pokémon can live in dirty streams and adapt to many environments. Once its sharp pincers catch prey, it rarely lets go.

name: Crawdaunt
description: Crawdaunt is rough and aggressive, and it rams into any foe that comes near its nest.

name: Baltoy
description: This mysterious Pokémon has been found in ruins from ancient civilizations. It spins on one foot to move and somehow stays upright while asleep.

name: Claydol
description: Claydol is said to have come to life from a clay figure made by ancient people. Its psychic abilities let it hover and fire beams from its arms.

name: Lileep
description: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petal-like tentacles.

name: Cradily
description: Cradily anchors itself on the seafloor in warm, shallow seas. It catches prey with eight tentacles and dissolves it with digestive fluid.

name: Anorith
description: Anorith is an early bug Pokémon brought back to life from a fossil. It uses eight flipper-like wings to swim and its claws to catch prey among rocks.

name: Armaldo
description: Once it leaves the water for land, Armaldo gains a sturdier lower body. Its huge claws can punch through metal-like defenses.

name: Feebas
description: Feebas is a shabby and ugly Pokémon, but it’s very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
description: Milotic is considered one of the most beautiful Pokémon. The sight of its graceful form is said to calm anger and soothe hostile feelings.

name: Castform
description: This Pokémon can change its cells, taking different forms based on the temperature and humidity.

name: Kecleon
description: Camouflage comes naturally to Kecleon, but its belly pattern always gives it away. A sudden fright can restore its usual colors.

name: Shuppet
description: Shuppet is drawn to dark feelings such as jealousy, resentment, and revenge. It wanders at night, feeding on these emotions with its horn.

name: Banette
description: A powerful grudge transformed this forgotten doll into Banette. It drives pins into its own body to generate energy for casting curses.

name: Duskull
description: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. Duskull has the ability to slip through thick walls.

name: Dusclops
description: This eerie Pokémon is said to be empty inside, like a black hole. It can swallow objects of any size, and nothing is known to return.

name: Tropius
description: Tropius grows clusters of sweet fruit around its neck, which children enjoy as snacks. It flies by flapping the broad leaves on its back.

name: Chimecho
description: Chimecho rides the wind and plucks berries with its tail. When angered, its ringing cries swell into ultrasonic waves.

name: Absol
description: This Pokémon detects subtle changes in the land and sky that signal danger. Many mistake it for a bringer of doom when it arrives before calamity.

name: Wynaut
description: Wynaut’s smile rarely fades, but its tail reveals a bad mood. At night, groups press together to build counterattack strength.

name: Snorunt
description: Snorunt survives by eating only snow and ice. Old folklore claims that a house visited by this Pokémon is sure to prosper for many generations to come.

name: Glalie
description: A layer of ice armor protects Glalie’s rocky body from harm. It can freeze its foes solid with chilling air and then devour them.

name: Spheal
description: Spheal’s round body is covered in thick, fluffy fur that keeps it warm on ice floes. It travels faster by rolling than by walking or swimming.

name: Sealeo
description: Sealeo balances unfamiliar objects on its sensitive nose to test their scent and texture. It often rolls Spheal around this way as a playful game.

name: Walrein
description: Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.

name: Clamperl
description: Clamperl’s shell protects its soft body and helps it catch prey. Once in its life, it creates a pearl said to hold mysterious energy.

name: Huntail
description: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

name: Gorebyss
description: A slender snout makes Gorebyss look refined, but it serves a grim purpose. After feeding, its pale pink body becomes more vivid.

name: Relicanth
description: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100 million years, so it’s called a living fossil.

name: Luvdisc
description: Luvdisc lives in warm, shallow tropical seas and often nests among Corsola’s branches. Its heart-shaped body has made it a symbol of romance.

name: Bagon
description: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

name: Shelgon
description: Shelgon barely eats while waiting to evolve, enduring hunger to grow stronger. Its tough shell sheds as soon as evolution begins.

name: Salamence
description: Few sights are as wild as Salamence wheeling through the sky in delight. Anger changes that joy into a fiery rampage.

name: Beldum
description: The cells in Beldum’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through its body.

name: Metang
description: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

name: Metagross
description: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

name: Regirock
description: Made entirely of stone, Regirock can replace chipped pieces with fresh rocks. Its body holds no known brain or heart.

name: Regice
description: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. Not even fire and magma can make it melt.

name: Registeel
description: Registeel’s body is harder than any known metal, yet it can shrink and stretch with surprising flexibility. Its hollow interior remains a mystery.

name: Latias
description: Latias can communicate with people through telepathy. If it senses hostility, it ruffles its feathers and cries sharply to scare off foes.

name: Latios
description: Latios understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It’s a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Kyogre
description: This Pokémon is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

name: Groudon
description: Groudon has the power to scatter rain clouds and make water evaporate with light and heat. It came as a savior to people who had been suffering from terrible floods.

name: Rayquaza
description: Rayquaza’s home lies so high that its existence went unseen for centuries. It feeds on particles in the atmosphere and meteoroids.

name: Jirachi
description: Jirachi is said to grant wishes written on the notes attached to its head when it awakens. It sleeps for a thousand years at a time.

name: Deoxys
description: Born from a mutated virus from space, Deoxys wields psychic force and lasers. Its body can alter its structure to absorb attacks.

name: Turtwig
description: A tiny leaf sprouts from Turtwig’s head and droops when it needs water. Its earthy shell grows firmer after it drinks.

name: Grotle
description: The berries growing on Grotle’s back attract other Pokémon looking for a snack. It also knows where pure spring water can be found.

name: Torterra
description: This large-bodied Pokémon looks like a miniature landscape, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness looking for clean water.

name: Chimchar
description: Full of energy, Chimchar climbs and bounds across rocky terrain with ease. It carefully extinguishes its flame before settling down to sleep.

name: Monferno
description: The brighter its blue face markings, the higher Monferno’s rank in the group. It leaps from walls and ceilings, striking with fists and fire.

name: Infernape
description: Infernape is a tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

name: Piplup
description: Strong swimming lets Piplup dive for more than ten minutes to hunt. On land, it often tumbles, then proudly puffs out its chest.

name: Prinplup
description: This Pokémon swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

name: Empoleon
description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Starly
description: Starly’s wings are strong for its size. In large flocks, sharp cries make a noisy chorus over fields and hills.

name: Staravia
description: Staravia sticks with its flock while hunting bugs in woods and fields. When groups collide, territorial squabbles erupt.

name: Staraptor
description: Staraptor leaves the flock once it’s strong enough to survive on its own. Its powerful flight lets it snatch up and carry away even big, burly targets.

name: Bidoof
description: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

name: Bibarel
description: Bibarel’s fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

name: Kricketot
description: Kricketot makes xylophone-like music by knocking its stiff antennae together. Its clacking sounds are often heard when autumn colors appear.

name: Kricketune
description: Kricketune makes music with its cutlass-like arms. The melody varies from one individual to the next, so listeners enjoy seeking out their favorite tunes.

name: Shinx
description: Shinx’s muscles generate electricity, making its fur glow. A trembling body can signal that a powerful jolt is coming.

name: Luxio
description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
description: Luxray’s golden eyes can see through solid objects, including thick walls. This lets it find hidden prey and locate its missing young.

name: Budew
description: When the sun’s light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon’s head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

name: Roserade
description: A sweet scent draws prey to Roserade, but thorned whips hide in its bouquets. Each hand carries a different poison.

name: Cranidos
description: This prehistoric Pokémon used its skull to smash trees and bring down prey. It was strong, though not especially clever.

name: Rampardos
description: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.

name: Shieldon
description: Shieldon lived in ancient jungles and had facial hide tough enough to withstand damage. It often polished its face by rubbing against tree trunks.

name: Bastiodon
description: Gentle Bastiodon feeds on grass and berries, relying on its sturdy face for defense. Side by side, a group can create a barrier few foes can break.

name: Burmy
description: Burmy shields itself from cold with a cloak of twigs and leaves. If damaged, it quickly rebuilds the covering with nearby materials.

name: Wormadam
description: When Burmy evolves, its cloak becomes part of Wormadam’s body and is never shed. Its appearance varies according to the materials around it.

name: Mothim
description: Mothim loves floral honey but rarely gathers any itself. Instead, it flutters through fields and steals the stores made by Combee.

name: Combee
description: Combee works tirelessly to collect honey for Vespiquen. At night, many Combee cluster together, forming a hive-like mass as they sleep.

name: Vespiquen
description: Vespiquen’s abdomen contains six cells where its grubs live and grow. It releases special scents to direct them during battles and protect the nest.

name: Pachirisu
description: Pachirisu is calm and gentle, but the electricity stored in its tail and cheeks can give a painful shock to anyone who touches them.

name: Buizel
description: Buizel moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. Its resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

name: Floatzel
description: Fishing ports often see Floatzel near the waterline. Its buoyant sac helps it rescue drowning people and haul prey ashore.

name: Cherubi
description: Cherubi’s extra fruit is more than decoration; it’s a nutrient stash. When reserves run out, the little ball withers.

name: Cherrim
description: Cherrim seems to save all its energy for bright days. Its petals unfold to soak up sunlight, then close tight when skies dim.

name: Shellos
description: Shellos lives along shores, and its appearance depends on its habitat and food. Squeezing its soft body can make purple fluid ooze out.

name: Gastrodon
description: It eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

name: Ambipom
description: With two dexterous tails, Ambipom can crack nuts and perform tasks without using its arms. Groups link tails together as a sign of kinship.

name: Drifloon
description: Drifloon floats aimlessly through the air and tugs at children’s hands like a balloon. Folklore warns that children who hold on may disappear.

name: Drifblim
description: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its fleeting, melancholy look touches some people deeply, and songs and poems have been written about Drifblim.

name: Buneary
description: Buneary can attack by rolling up its ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Lopunny
description: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

name: Mismagius
description: Mismagius chants in a strange, murmuring voice that sounds like magic spells. Its cries are said to bring misfortune to those who hear them.

name: Honchkrow
description: Night belongs to this ruthless Pokémon, whose Murkrow cronies do its bidding. Betrayal is repaid with a relentless hunt.

name: Glameow
description: It bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
description: Purugly’s luxurious fur is admired despite its impudent nature. It wraps its tails around its waist to make itself look bigger.

name: Chingling
description: There may be no sound to human ears, yet Chingling can still cry loudly. An orb in its mouth rings with every bouncing step.

name: Stunky
description: Stunky sprays a foul-smelling fluid from its rear to drive away attackers. The stench can linger for a full day and spread over a wide area.

name: Skuntank
description: A threat sends Skuntank’s belly fluid shooting from its tail. Its diet changes the stench, which can spoil its meal.

name: Bronzor
description: Bronzor floats with mysterious energy. Its engraved back pattern appears in ancient tombs and sacred images.

name: Bronzong
description: Bronzong’s ringing cry is said to open portals to another world. Long ago, people revered it as a bringer of rain and good harvests.

name: Bonsly
description: This Pokémon lives in dry, rocky areas. The luster of its green spheres changes as they dry out.

name: Mime Jr.
description: This Pokémon mimics the expressions and movements of those around it and enjoys busy places where it can watch people.

name: Happiny
description: Happiny carries an egg-shaped rock to imitate Chansey. It enjoys playing house with children and sharing its stone.

name: Chatot
description: A talented mimic and a chatterbox, Chatot picks up words quickly and repeats them with surprising accuracy.

name: Spiritomb
description: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Old writings say that this Pokémon was born from the gathering of 108 malevolent spirits.

name: Gible
description: A passing shadow can trigger Gible’s sudden pounce. It drags prey into a crevice, though its small stomach can’t hold much.

name: Gabite
description: Gabite hoards gems in its cave, guarding them with claws and fangs. Its shed scales are prized in traditional medicine.

name: Garchomp
description: Garchomp folds its body and spreads its wings like a jet, reaching sonic speed. Its fine scales reduce drag and can cut attackers.

name: Munchlax
description: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. Munchlax pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

name: Riolu
description: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu’s approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

name: Lucario
description: Lucario reads its opponent’s feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.

name: Hippopotas
description: It spends much of its time buried beneath the soil, which makes this large, languid Pokémon hard to find. Sand shoots from its nostrils when it’s agitated or excited.

name: Hippowdon
description: This bulky, hot-tempered Pokémon lives in sandy lands. It’s quick to anger and quick to attack.

name: Skorupi
description: Skorupi can endure a year without food while hidden beneath the sand. Once prey nears, its pincers strike with venom.

name: Drapion
description: Drapion’s head swivels a full 180 degrees, leaving no blind spot. It can wreck a car with its claws, toxin or no toxin.

name: Croagunk
description: Croagunk rarely fights fairly, relying on clever tricks to survive. It puffs out its poison-filled cheeks before jabbing foes with toxic fingers.

name: Toxicroak
description: Toxicroak sways around incoming blows, then lunges with venomous knuckles. Its victory croak sounds when prey falls.

name: Carnivine
description: Sweet-smelling drool draws curious prey toward Carnivine’s gaping maw. It may take a whole day to finish a meal.

name: Finneon
description: Finneon’s pink markings soak up sunlight, then glow after dark. Its fluttering tail fins have earned it a sea-butterfly nickname.

name: Lumineon
description: Like stars fallen beneath the waves, Lumineon’s fins gleam in deep water. It crawls across the seabed on its chest fins.

name: Mantyke
description: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they will all fight together to repel attackers.

name: Snover
description: Snowy peaks are home to Snover, whose belly grows berries like ice pops. Curious ones sometimes gather around human footprints.

name: Abomasnow
description: Abomasnow is strong enough to split huge boulders. It prefers a quiet life deep in the snowy mountains, far from other Pokémon.

name: Weavile
description: Weavile hunts in coordinated packs and leaves claw marks on trees to communicate. A scratch from its claws can cause frostbite.

name: Magnezone
description: A special magnetic field caused Magnezone to evolve from Magneton. Its three units work together to generate powerful magnetism.

name: Lickilicky
description: Clumsy fingers can’t match Lickilicky’s dexterous tongue. It stretches over ten times its height, leaving corrosive drool.

name: Rhyperior
description: Rhyperior’s armored hide shrugs off stone-shattering blows. Its palms double as projectile launchers.

name: Tangrowth
description: Stillness makes Tangrowth look like a shaggy shrub. Get too close, and its bundled vines lash out to snare unsuspecting prey.

name: Electivire
description: One Electivire can power a large city for a year. In battle, its twin tails unleash over 20,000 volts.

name: Magmortar
description: Magmortar fires blazing shots from its tube-shaped arms. The flames are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

name: Togekiss
description: Togekiss appears where people live in harmony and avoid needless strife. Its rare visits are said to bring kindness, good fortune, and many blessings.

name: Yanmega
description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Leafeon
description: Leafeon prefers not to fight and often rests in sunny patches. While it photosynthesizes, its body helps keep the surrounding air clear.

name: Glaceon
description: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Gliscor
description: Gliscor hangs upside down, watching for the perfect moment to swoop. Its silent glide makes the attack almost impossible to hear.

name: Mamoswine
description: A frozen Mamoswine was found after 10,000 years. Its ancient shape appears in paintings from that era.

name: Porygon-Z
description: Porygon-Z was given extra software to make it more advanced. The update seems faulty, causing its movements to become strange.

name: Gallade
description: The blades extending from Gallade’s elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

name: Probopass
description: Probopass uses strong magnetism to control three small units called Mini-Noses. They can attack an opponent from different directions.

name: Dusknoir
description: The antenna on its head picks up radio waves from the world of spirits. The waves command it to take people there.

name: Froslass
description: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. Froslass only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

name: Rotom
description: Rotom is plasma that slips into machines to cause chaos. Its electric mischief can make appliances act bizarrely.

name: Uxie
description: Uxie is known as the Being of Knowledge. Legends say its appearance gave people the wisdom to solve problems.

name: Mesprit
description: Mesprit sleeps beneath a lake, yet its spirit skims the surface. Legends say it taught people joy and sorrow.

name: Azelf
description: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.

name: Dialga
description: Dialga is a legendary Pokémon said to control time. Myths claim time began to flow when it was born.

name: Palkia
description: Palkia crosses the limits of space to reach other dimensions. Legends credit its birth with opening a sky without end.

name: Heatran
description: Heatran crawls across cave walls and ceilings with its cross-shaped feet. Its rugged steel body is partly melted by its own heat.

name: Regigigas
description: Regigigas is said to have shaped Regirock, Regice, and Registeel from different materials. Ancient tales claim it moved continents across the world.

name: Giratina
description: Banished for its violence, Giratina dwells in a strange dimension. Its shadowy form seems to bend nature’s rules.

name: Cresselia
description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It’s said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Phione
description: This gentle sea Pokémon spends its days floating on warm waves. The sac on its head swells with air to keep it buoyant.

name: Manaphy
description: Manaphy is born with a special power that lets it bond with any Pokémon. It can swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

name: Darkrai
description: Darkrai can cause people to have nightmares, especially on moonless nights. Folklore says it does this to protect itself, not to cause harm.

name: Shaymin
description: When Shaymin feels gratitude and affection, the flowers on its body bloom. It can also cleanse polluted air and restore damaged land.

name: Arceus
description: Myth says Arceus emerged from an egg when nothing else existed. From that emptiness, it shaped the world and universe.

name: Victini
description: Victory seems to follow wherever Victini goes. This tiny Pokémon creates boundless energy and shares it through touch.

name: Snivy
description: Calm and clever, Snivy relies on vines more deftly than its hands. A good sunbath makes its already swift movements quicker.

name: Servine
description: Servine slides along the ground with graceful speed. It dodges attacks in thick foliage and strikes back with precise vine whips.

name: Serperior
description: One regal glare from Serperior can freeze an opponent in place. It saves its full strength for foes that remain unfazed.

name: Tepig
description: Tepig loves roasted berries, but it sometimes burns them by getting too excited. It can also dodge attacks while firing fireballs from its nose.

name: Pignite
description: The more Pignite eats, the hotter its belly flame burns. When trouble strikes, smoke pours out as its movements sharpen.

name: Emboar
description: Emboar fights with speed and strength, setting its fists ablaze for powerful punches. Its fiery beard flares when it gets fired up.

name: Oshawott
description: Oshawott’s belly shell detaches to become a blade. Between fights, it also cracks open hard berries for a snack.

name: Dewott
description: Dewott learns its flowing double-scalchop technique through strict training. Each one develops its own style and maintains its scalchops.

name: Samurott
description: Silence can fall at the sound of Samurott’s cry. Its leg armor conceals a sword capable of felling an opponent in one swing.

name: Patrat
description: Patrat stores food in its cheeks and can keep watch for days. Its tail signals to others, while a lookout guards the nest.

name: Watchog
description: Watchog raises its tail when it spots an enemy. It can spit berry seeds from its cheek pouches and see clearly in the dark.

name: Lillipup
description: This clever Pokémon remembers both kindness and mistreatment. Its sensitive facial fur helps it detect even small changes nearby.

name: Herdier
description: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Stoutland
description: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive mustache. It’s said that mustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Purrloin
description: This mischievous Pokémon steals valuables simply to amuse itself. Its victims often forgive the prank despite the trouble it causes.

name: Liepard
description: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Pansage
description: Pansage plucks berries from all over the forest and shares its haul. The leaf atop its head can ease weariness and stress.

name: Simisage
description: Simisage may lash out with its barbed tail when riled. Its head leaf is bitter enough to deter a bold berry eater.

name: Pansear
description: Pansear turns a simple berry into a warm snack with the fire on its head. Anger makes that tuft blaze hotter.

name: Simisear
description: Simisear’s head tuft holds a pocket of fire that glows when excited. A sweet scent can trail behind it.

name: Panpour
description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
description: Simipour stores water in its head tuft and refills it with its tail. Its pressurized stream can break concrete.

name: Munna
description: Munna eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
description: It drowses and dreams all the time. A freshly woken Musharna is a terrible grump, so it’s better left alone.

name: Pidove
description: City parks and plazas often fill with Pidove flocks. They’re used to people, though complex orders confuse them.

name: Tranquill
description: Tranquill finds its way through the densest forest without hesitation. Its quiet flight makes it hard to notice.

name: Unfezant
description: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Blitzle
description: Lightning can be stored in Blitzle’s mane. When it discharges, bright flashes help the herd communicate.

name: Zebstrika
description: Zebstrika’s full-speed runs rumble like thunder. This short-tempered Pokémon can unleash bolts of lightning from its mane when provoked.

name: Roggenrola
description: A warm energy core sits inside Roggenrola’s steel-hard body. Its hexagonal ear turns toward noises, and it starts moving that way.

name: Boldore
description: Boldore’s bright crystals signal overflowing inner power. It senses sounds and water, but its body always faces one way.

name: Gigalith
description: Gigalith absorbs sunlight through the orange crystals on its body. Its inner core magnifies that energy and fires powerful blasts from its mouth.

name: Woobat
description: Woobat uses ultrasonic waves from its nose to sense its surroundings. It sleeps clinging to cave walls, leaving heart-shaped marks behind.

name: Swoobat
description: Swoobat’s nose produces ultrasonic waves that can shatter rocks. Using such powerful sounds tires it out and may leave it unable to fly for a while.

name: Drilbur
description: Like a living auger, Drilbur rotates to burrow fast. Its digging can race a car, though crops may suffer.

name: Excadrill
