description: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.

name: Audino
description: Audino is kindhearted, and its feelers let it read the moods and the physical condition of anyone it touches.

name: Timburr
description: Timburr loves helping build things and carries a squared log everywhere. If rain stops the work, it may swing its log around in frustration.

name: Gurdurr
description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers couldn’t make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
description: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Tympole
description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Throh
description: Throwing larger foes is Throh’s favorite challenge. Its belt darkens with sweat as its strength grows.

name: Sawk
description: The sound of Sawk striking boulders and trees carries through the mountains. It trains relentlessly and dislikes anyone interrupting its practice.

name: Sewaddle
description: This small Pokémon fashions clothing from leaves using thread from its mouth. Its hood keeps it cozy, and it hides its head there when sleeping.

name: Swadloon
description: Dark, damp places suit Swadloon, which spends much of the day eating fallen leaves. The nutrients it produces help the forest’s plants flourish.

name: Leavanny
description: When Leavanny finds a small Pokémon, it may sew a warm outfit from leaves. It also wraps Sewaddle in leafy clothing and keeps its eggs warm.

name: Venipede
description: Feelers at both ends help Venipede read tiny vibrations in the air. Its venomous bite can paralyze a much larger bird.

name: Whirlipede
description: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it will need for evolution.

name: Scolipede
description: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

name: Cottonee
description: Cottonee shoots cotton as a decoy when attacked. It drifts with the wind but shelters under trees when rain weighs it down.

name: Whimsicott
description: This playful Pokémon can squeeze through the tiniest openings. It rides the wind into houses and leaves white fluff behind as a prank.

name: Petilil
description: The leaves on its head are valued as a medicinal herb. Brewed into a tea, they’re bitter but remarkably good at relieving fatigue.

name: Lilligant
description: The oils made from Lilligant’s flowers smell wonderful and cost a fortune. Its beautiful blooms are especially admired by celebrities.

name: Basculin
description: Red-striped Basculin has fatty meat that appeals especially to younger diners. In the wild, Basculin of different colors often clash on sight.

name: Sandile
description: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

name: Krokorok
description: Krokorok travels in small groups through the desert. A special membrane over its eyes detects heat, helping it see even in darkness.

name: Krookodile
description: This aggressive Pokémon can wait beneath the sand for days before ambushing prey. Its crushing jaws are strong enough to destroy an automobile.

name: Darumaka
description: Darumaka’s inner fire keeps it energetic, and it runs around when the flames burn strongly. As the fire fades, it curls up and falls asleep.

name: Darmanitan
description: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Maractus
description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Dwebble
description: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Crustle
description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

name: Scraggy
description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
description: Scrafty fiercely defends its territory and spits acidic liquid at intruders. Despite its rough attitude, it cares for family and friends.

name: Sigilyph
description: Sigilyph follows the same flight route daily, as if guarding an ancient city. It uses psychic power to attack intruders.

name: Yamask
description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Cofagrigus
description: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Tirtouga
description: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

name: Carracosta
description: A blow from Carracosta’s strong front limbs can punch a hole in a tanker. It also devours prey whole, crunching through shells and bones.

name: Archen
description: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

name: Archeops
description: Archeops is an intelligent hunter that works with its kind to catch prey. It takes a running start on the ground before spreading its wings to fly.

name: Trubbish
description: Trubbish’s body is shaped like a garbage bag filled with toxic sludge. It’s drawn to any pile of trash it can find.

name: Garbodor
description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can finish off a weakened foe instantly.

name: Zorua
description: Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.

name: Zoroark
description: With its disheveled white fur, Zoroark looks like an embodiment of death. It attacks its nemeses with bitter energy so intense that it hurts its own body.

name: Minccino
description: A tidy home is important to Minccino, which uses its tail like a broom. When meeting another of its kind, it exchanges a thorough tail grooming.

name: Cinccino
description: Cinccino’s body produces a smooth oil that keeps its fur pristine. The substance is prized for its soothing effect on skin.

name: Gothita
description: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

name: Gothorita
description: Gothorita draws power from starlight and marks star positions with psychic energy. Old tales warn that it can hypnotize people and lead them astray.

name: Gothitelle
description: Gothitelle predicts the future by studying the stars. Its psychic power distorts space, revealing distant starry skies.

name: Solosis
description: A protective liquid envelops Solosis and may let it survive almost anywhere. When threatened, it uses psychic energy to drive enemies away.

name: Duosion
description: Duosion’s brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
description: Its liquid arms grip with rock-crushing force under psychic control. Legends say Reuniclus’s fluid grants wisdom, but it’s poisonous to others.

name: Ducklett
description: Ducklett is a skilled diver that swims underwater to eat peat moss. When attacked, it splashes water with its feathers and escapes behind the spray.

name: Swanna
description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
description: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

name: Vanillish
description: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

name: Vanilluxe
description: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

name: Deerling
description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
description: Sawsbuck move from place to place as the seasons turn. Their changing horns have made them a natural sign of the season for many people.

name: Emolga
description: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Karrablast
description: Karrablast’s evolution is tied to encounters with Shelmet and electricity. This odd pairing can transform both Pokémon.

name: Escavalier
description: Escavalier’s armor hides nearly all its body, leaving only its eyes exposed. It charges with twin horns held like lances.

name: Foongus
description: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Amoonguss
description: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Frillish
description: A gauzy embrace from Frillish is a dangerous trap. Poisonous arms wrap around prey and pull it toward the ocean floor.

name: Jellicent
description: Jellicent gathers near the sea’s surface on full-moon nights to hunt. Legends say ships entering its habitat vanish beneath the waves.

name: Alomomola
description: This gentle Pokémon cares for weak and injured sea creatures. Its special coating helps heal wounds, and it cradles patients safely in its fins.

name: Joltik
description: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

name: Galvantula
description: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that aren’t yet good at flying.

name: Ferroseed
description: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
description: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Klink
description: A steady spin keeps Klink supplied with the energy it needs to live. Its two gears mesh only with each other.

name: Klang
description: Klang changes its rotation to express feelings and spins faster when angry. It can launch its minigear at high speed, but must get it back.

name: Klinklang
description: Three gears whirl together inside Klinklang’s body. A red core stores power for sudden electric blasts.

name: Tynamo
description: Tynamo travel in schools and generate electricity with a special organ. When danger threatens, they discharge current to defend themselves.

name: Eelektrik
description: A hungry Eelektrik wraps around its catch and paralyzes it with the electric spots on its body. Dinner rarely gets away.

name: Eelektross
description: From the sea, Eelektross can crawl onto shore with its strong arms. It shocks prey before dragging it back underwater.

name: Elgyem
description: Elgyem’s psychic power can squeeze an opponent’s brain and cause terrible headaches. Its strange looks have fueled rumors of alien origins.

name: Beheeyem
description: Beheeyem can alter the memories of others with its psychic powers. It may communicate by flashing its three differently colored fingers.

name: Litwick
description: Litwick’s eerie flame feeds on the life energy of people and Pokémon. It may pretend to guide lost travelers while secretly draining their strength.

name: Lampent
description: A wandering Lampent may look like an ordinary lamp at first glance. It waits near the dying, ready to steal a departing spirit.

name: Chandelure
description: This ghostly Pokémon haunts crumbling mansions and sways its arms to entrance its foes. Those caught in its flames may lose their spirits.

name: Axew
description: Axew uses its sturdy tusks to crush the hard berries it eats. If a tusk breaks, it grows back quickly, usually stronger than before.

name: Fraxure
description: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

name: Haxorus
description: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Haxorus deals with its adversaries using tusks that can slice through steel beams.

name: Cubchoo
description: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn’t like.

name: Beartic
description: Beartic can freeze its breath into a fearsome set of icy fangs. It rules cold waters with powerful strokes and hunts prey beneath the waves.

name: Cryogonal
description: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

name: Shelmet
description: When threatened, Shelmet shuts its shell tight and can spit a sticky, poisonous fluid. Its unusual body reacts to electricity in unexpected ways.

name: Accelgor
description: Accelgor can move with astonishing speed and attack by hurling poison. Layers of delicate membrane help keep its body from dehydrating.

name: Stunfisk
description: Stunfisk lies in mud, waiting for prey to come close enough to touch it. Then it delivers an electric jolt, grinning as the current flows.

name: Mienfoo
description: Mienfoo may be small, but it’s fierce, and it greets careless visitors with a flurry of graceful strikes.

name: Mienshao
description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Druddigon
description: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Golett
description: It’s an ancient clay Pokémon that has kept carrying out the same orders ever since it was made.

name: Golurk
description: Golurk can soar through the sky at incredible speeds. If the seal on its chest is removed, its inner energy may spiral out of control.

name: Pawniard
description: Groups of Pawniard follow a Bisharp and work together to hunt prey. Each one trains hard, hoping to become the leader someday.

name: Bisharp
description: Bisharp commands a group of Pawniard and directs them to corner prey. It then moves in to deliver the finishing blow with its sharp blades.

name: Bouffalant
description: A charging Bouffalant can send a train flying. Its thick, fluffy coat cushions the impact when its head meets a target.

name: Rufflet
description: Rufflet challenges foes far larger than itself. Its fearless nature often gets it into fights it can’t yet win.

name: Braviary
description: This proud bird Pokémon fears little and rushes into battle with a piercing cry. Legends praise Braviary as a courageous warrior of the sky.

name: Vullaby
description: Young Vullaby wear bones gathered by older Mandibuzz to shield their backsides. As they grow too big for a bone, they pass it to a smaller nestmate.

name: Mandibuzz
description: Mandibuzz uses bones to build nests and decorate its body. Fashion trends seem to change which bones this Pokémon prefers to wear.

name: Heatmor
description: Heatmor draws air through a hole in its tail to keep its inner fire burning. It hunts Durant for food.

name: Durant
description: A Durant colony works like a machine, with each member playing a role. They fight Heatmor with powerful mandibles.

name: Deino
description: Deino can’t see, so it bites and bumps into things to learn about its surroundings. It isn’t picky about food, making a careless approach risky.

name: Zweilous
description: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Hydreigon
description: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

name: Larvesta
description: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

name: Volcarona
description: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

name: Cobalion
description: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

name: Terrakion
description: Terrakion defended Pokémon whose homes were lost in human wars. Its powerful charge can smash through a stone wall in one blow.

name: Virizion
description: Virizion protects its friends with swift, whirlwind-like movements. The blade-sharp horns on its head can slice opponents before they can react.

name: Tornadus
description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Thundurus
description: Thundurus fires lightning from the spikes on its tail as it flies. Its feud with Tornadus is said to bring storms and destruction.

name: Reshiram
description: Reshiram is a legendary Pokémon tied to the ideal of truth. Myth says it will burn down kingdoms whose people abandon truth and give in to greed.

name: Zekrom
description: Zekrom’s tail contains a huge generator that produces electricity. When its inner part spins like a motor, lightning bolts fly in every direction.

name: Landorus
description: Landorus is said to bless the fields, making crops grow abundantly wherever it visits. It can calm the storms caused by Tornadus and Thundurus.

name: Kyurem
description: This legendary Pokémon produces air cold enough to freeze its surroundings. Its body remains frozen, as though its inner energy escaped control.

name: Keldeo
description: When Keldeo becomes resolute, its body surges with power and speed. Its forehead horn must fully develop before its true strength awakens.

name: Meloetta
description: A song from Meloetta can make listeners feel happiness or sadness. Its unusual vocal technique gives its music a power beyond ordinary melodies.

name: Genesect
description: This Pokémon roamed the world 300 million years ago before being modified by humans, who equipped its back with a powerful cannon.

name: Chespin
description: Chespin’s thick wooden shell can withstand powerful blows. It can stiffen its head quills until they’re hard enough to pierce stone.

name: Quilladin
description: Its tough shell helps Quilladin withstand attacks from predators. When threatened, it counters with sharp quills.

name: Chesnaught
description: When Chesnaught guards its face with its fists, it can withstand a bomb blast. Its sturdy body makes it a dependable protector.

name: Fennekin
description: Fennekin snacks on twigs to fuel its inner fire. Hot air escapes from its ears when it grows excited.

name: Braixen
description: A twig hidden in Braixen’s tail becomes a weapon when friction sets it ablaze. It can also use the flame to communicate with allies.

name: Delphox
description: Delphox uses the flame on its branch to steady its thoughts and see the future. It can also unleash a blazing psychic whirlpool.

name: Froakie
description: The bubbles around Froakie’s neck aren’t just decoration. They cushion attacks and help this nimble Pokémon slip away from danger.

name: Frogadier
description: Quick on its feet and precise with its throws, Frogadier uses bubble-covered stones to strike distant targets before they can react.

name: Greninja
description: Silent and swift, Greninja vanishes from sight before an opponent can react. Its water-made stars fly like blades through the air.

name: Bunnelby
description: Bunnelby uses its large ears like shovels to dig deep burrows. Digging strengthens them until they can slice through thick roots.

name: Diggersby
description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Fletchling
description: A sweet song often announces Fletchling’s arrival, but its nature isn’t always gentle. It fiercely defends its territory with swift, precise strikes.

name: Fletchinder
description: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

name: Talonflame
description: Talonflame rockets toward prey, scattering embers from its feathers at high speed. A powerful kick ends the hunt.

name: Scatterbug
description: Scatterbug can thrive in many climates thanks to the powder covering its body. When threatened by bird Pokémon, it may scatter a paralyzing toxin.

name: Spewpa
description: Spewpa hides in thickets beneath a coat of powdery fur. When threatened, it bristles to make itself look dangerous.

name: Vivillon
description: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Litleo
description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
description: The largest mane of fire marks the leader of a Pyroar pride. Males may seem lazy, but they bravely defend their friends when danger strikes.

name: Flabébé
description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it has collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Floette
description: The more beautiful a flower, the more power Floette can draw from it. It lovingly tends flower beds and fiercely resents anyone who ruins them.

name: Florges
description: Florges draws strength from the energy released by flowering plants. It can unleash petal blizzards whose beauty matches their power.

name: Skiddo
description: Skiddo was among the first Pokémon said to live peacefully with humans. If it has sunlight and water, leaves on its back can supply its energy.

name: Gogoat
description: Gogoat live in mountainous areas. Herd leaders are chosen through clashes of their horns.

name: Pancham
description: Pancham keeps a leaf in its mouth to look cool and serious. Despite its best efforts to scare others, it often breaks into a grin.

name: Pangoro
description: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Furfrou
description: Furfrou’s fluffy coat grows longer when left untrimmed, and a haircut can make it more agile. It only lets someone it trusts cut its fur.

name: Espurr
description: Espurr’s face rarely changes as it struggles to restrain its psychic power. The energy it releases can send a wrestler flying.

name: Meowstic
description: Meowstic hides its ear patterns for good reason. Those eye-like marks unleash psychic force strong enough to crush a truck.

name: Honedge
description: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
description: Two blades move as one when Doublade attacks. The twin swords coordinate telepathically, switching between offense and defense.

name: Aegislash
description: Aegislash can manipulate people with its spectral power. Legends say it once helped a king rule an entire kingdom.

name: Spritzee
description: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
description: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

name: Swirlix
description: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Slurpuff
description: Slurpuff can distinguish even the faintest scents and help pastry chefs with their work. Its nose can also reveal clues about a person’s condition.

name: Inkay
description: Inkay flashes the glowing spots on its body to daze opponents and drain their will to fight. It then uses the opening to flee and hide.

name: Malamar
description: Malamar possesses powerful hypnotic abilities that can force others to obey its will. It’s said these powers have changed the course of history.

name: Binacle
description: If the two Binacle that share a rock don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

name: Barbaracle
description: Barbaracle consists of several Binacle joined together, with a head-hand directing the rest. Its claws grip and strike hard.

name: Skrelp
description: Skrelp resembles rotten seaweed and drifts among it to hide. It waits for unsuspecting Pokémon to approach before spraying them with poison.

name: Dragalge
description: Dragalge raises the plume on its head above the ocean to absorb sunlight and generate dragon energy. Ships entering its territory may never return.

name: Clauncher
description: Clauncher fires compressed water from its right claw like a pistol. The powerful shot can knock flying prey down or shatter nearby rock.

name: Clawitzer
description: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from its cannon arm can sink a tanker.

name: Helioptile
description: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
description: A single Heliolisk can power a skyscraper with the electricity it generates. It uses current to strengthen its legs and run fast.

name: Tyrunt
description: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it will tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.

name: Tyrantrum
description: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Amaura
description: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus
description: Aurorus can instantly create a wall of ice with its diamond-shaped crystals. Though gentle, its freezing breath can encase foes in ice.

name: Sylveon
description: Sylveon emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-like feelers to calm fights. It can wrap them around quarrelers and quickly restore peace.

name: Hawlucha
description: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Dedenne
description: This rascal Pokémon sneaks into homes to steal electricity from outlets. Its whiskers also transmit electrical signals over great distances.

name: Carbink
description: Carbink formed deep underground under immense heat and pressure. It can fire powerful beams from the jewel embedded in its body.

name: Goomy
description: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it’s nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, it instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Sliggoo
description: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

name: Goodra
description: It attacks by forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

name: Klefki
description: This even-tempered Pokémon loves collecting keys, sometimes sneaking into homes to find them. Its horn absorbs metal ions from solid metal.

name: Phantump
description: Old tales say Phantump are stumps inhabited by children’s spirits after they became lost in the forest. Their cries can lure travelers astray.

name: Trevenant
description: Its roots let Trevenant command nearby trees and protect its woodland home. Anyone who cuts down trees where it lives may suffer a deadly curse.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: A spirit inhabits Pumpkaboo’s pumpkin body, and it becomes active as the sun sets. It guides wandering spirits toward the afterlife.

name: Gourgeist
description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Bergmite
description: Bergmite’s icy body can withstand freezing temperatures. It clings to larger Pokémon when traveling across snowy terrain.

name: Avalugg
description: The ice forming Avalugg’s body is harder than steel. It plows through obstacles with the blunt force of a drifting glacier.

name: Noibat
description: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

name: Noivern
description: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Xerneas
description: A thousand-year slumber can leave Xerneas looking like a tree. Its radiant antlers are said to grant eternal life when they glow.

name: Yveltal
description: When Yveltal’s life nears its end, it absorbs surrounding life energy. It then returns to a cocoon-like form.

name: Zygarde
description: When the balance of an ecosystem is threatened, Zygarde emerges to restore order. Rumors suggest its true power goes beyond its known forms.

name: Diancie
description: Diancie’s shimmering pink body is considered one of the world’s most beautiful sights. It can instantly turn airborne carbon into diamonds.

name: Hoopa
description: This mischievous Pokémon teleports anything it likes through its space-bending rings. When its power is sealed, it takes on a much smaller form.

name: Volcanion
description: Steam surges from the arms on Volcanion’s back with tremendous force. This powerful blast can reportedly level a mountain in an instant.

name: Rowlet
description: This cautious Pokémon rests on the energy it gathers from sunlight. At night, it silently glides toward foes and attacks with sharp feathers or kicks.

name: Dartrix
description: Dartrix is a perfectionist about its plumage and may lose focus if its feathers get dirty. Its sharp blade quills rarely miss their targets.

name: Decidueye
description: Decidueye draws and fires its arrow quills in the blink of an eye. When a shot must land, it tugs the vine on its head to sharpen its focus.

name: Litten
description: Litten keeps to itself and is slow to trust anyone. It lashes out with sharp claws at those who get too close too soon.

name: Torracat
description: Torracat has powerful front legs that can bend an iron bar with one punch. Its fiery throat bell blazes brighter when its fighting spirit rises.

name: Incineroar
description: When Incineroar’s fighting spirit ignites, flames around its waist grow especially intense. It loves strong opponents but finds weaker foes boring.

name: Popplio
description: Popplio blows water balloons through its nose and practices daily to make them larger. Its hard work can turn the bubbles into powerful weapons.

name: Brionne
description: Brionne dances while creating water balloons to hurl at foes. It eagerly practices unfamiliar dances until every step is mastered.

name: Primarina
description: For Primarina, every battle is a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

name: Pikipek
description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. Pikipek can peck at a tree 16 times per second.

name: Trumbeak
description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
description: Toucannon’s beak heats up during battle and can become hot enough to cause severe burns. It’s also known as a good-luck charm at weddings.

name: Yungoos
description: Yungoos has sharp fangs and will bite almost anything. It spends much of its day searching for food.

name: Gumshoos
description: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it’s diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

name: Grubbin
description: Grubbin uses its strong jaws to scrape tree bark and drink the sap inside. It usually lives underground and may bite anyone who disturbs its nest.

name: Charjabug
description: Charjabug stores electricity inside its body. Its boxy shape makes it look like a living battery.

name: Vikavolt
description: Vikavolt stores electricity in its strong jaws and fires powerful beams. A Charjabug can serve as a spare battery while it flies.

name: Crabrawler
description: Crabrawler guards itself with hard pincers while seeking a chance to punch. Its battles resemble boxing matches, and lost pincers quickly regrow.

name: Crabominable
description: The shaggy coat covering Crabominable protects it from the cold. It swings its oversized claws with enough force to knock back much larger foes.

name: Oricorio
description: Oricorio changes its dance and appearance after sipping different nectar. Each style moves to its own rhythm.

name: Cutiefly
description: This tiny Pokémon can read an opponent’s aura to predict its next move. A nimble dodge can leave the foe striking empty air.

name: Ribombee
description: Ribombee rolls pollen and nectar into puffs with different effects. Some are nutritious snacks, while others are used to hinder opponents in battle.

name: Rockruff
description: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Lycanroc
description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Wishiwashi
description: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Mareanie
description: Mareanie uses its spiky arms to catch prey and strip coral from the seabed. Its cute face hides a prickly hunter.

name: Toxapex
description: Toxapex forms a dome with its 12 legs and shelters from the tides. Its poison is so potent that its effects can last for days.

name: Mudbray
description: Mudbray loves playing in mud and can become stressed if it goes without a daily muddy bath. Its stubborn nature makes it hard to persuade otherwise.

name: Mudsdale
description: Mudsdale can wreck a truck with one kick, aided by hardened mud armor. Its stamina matches its strength.

name: Dewpider
description: Dewpider wears a little pool like a helmet when it leaves water. Others of its kind may compare bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
description: Araquanid uses the bubble on its head to protect small Pokémon. It can also trap prey inside the watery dome.

name: Fomantis
description: The tip of Fomantis’s head gives off a pleasant aroma while it basks in the sun. Its colors grow brighter with regular sunlight.

name: Lurantis
description: Lurantis resembles a flower but fights like a blade dancer. Its sharp petals can slice through opponents with graceful precision.

name: Morelull
description: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

name: Shiinotic
description: Shiinotic’s glowing spores lure creatures into a deep sleep. Once they nod off, it drains their energy through its fingertips.

name: Salandit
description: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
description: Salazzle uses its pheromones to control groups of male Salandit. It lives deep in caves and can punish those that disobey.

name: Stufful
description: It looks like a stuffed toy, but this fluffy Pokémon packs real power. Its flailing arms can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
description: Bewear waves its arms as a warning, not a friendly greeting. A hug from this powerful Pokémon can crush bones.

name: Bounsweet
description: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
description: Bird Pokémon peck at Steenee, but its tough sepals keep it safe. It bounces cheerfully, seemingly unbothered.

name: Tsareena
description: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

name: Comfey
description: The flowers Comfey carries give off a calming scent. Without flowers on its vine, it can become uneasy and restless.

name: Oranguru
description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Passimian
description: Passimian work in tight-knit groups and use hard berries as weapons. The best thrower often leads the troop.

name: Wimpod
description: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

name: Golisopod
description: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

name: Sandygast
description: A child’s abandoned sandcastle can become Sandygast. The shovel on its head helps it control nearby sand and lure unsuspecting victims.

name: Palossand
description: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Pyukumuku
description: Pyukumuku live in shallow coastal waters and often wash up on beaches. Their sticky mucus can soothe sunburned skin.

name: Type: Null
description: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally
description: Silvally changes its type by switching the memory in its head. Its unusual design was created to adapt to many different threats.

name: Minior
description: Born high in the atmosphere, Minior gathers particles into a protective shell as it falls. A broken shell reveals a brightly colored core beneath.

name: Komala
description: Komala sleeps throughout its entire life, from birth until death. The sedative leaves it eats may explain why it never truly wakes.

name: Turtonator
description: Turtonator eats sulfur and minerals in volcanic regions, forming explosive material in its shell. Even its droppings can explode.

name: Togedemaru
description: Togedemaru’s back is covered in spiny fur that rises when it’s startled. The sharp spikes can stab anyone who comes too close.

name: Mimikyu
description: Mimikyu hides its frightening appearance beneath an old rag so it can approach others. Anyone who sees beneath the disguise may meet a terrible fate.

name: Bruxish
description: Bruxish hides beneath the sand and sends out psychic power from the bump on its head. It stuns prey before crushing it with strong teeth.

name: Drampa
description: Drampa is gentle with people, especially children, and visits towns to play. If angered, it can unleash a gale that destroys its surroundings.

name: Dhelmise
description: An old anchor and ship’s wheel form the body Dhelmise controls with seaweed. It uses ghostly energy to strike with surprising force.

name: Jangmo-o
description: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that has become as hard as metal.

name: Hakamo-o
description: A metallic clatter signals Hakamo-o is ready to fight. Its scales regrow continuously, sharper with each cycle.

name: Kommo-o
description: Kommo-o rattles the scales on its tail to frighten enemies. Its tough, metallic armor protects it while it attacks with powerful fists.

name: Tapu Koko
description: Tapu Koko flies so fast that enemies struggle to follow it with their eyes. It summons thunderclouds and absorbs the lightning they release.

name: Tapu Lele
description: Tapu Lele’s scales shine as they drift around it and are known to heal. Despite its sacred status, it can be cruel without remorse.

name: Tapu Bulu
description: Tapu Bulu controls vegetation and is known for its strength. It often rings its tail to warn others and avoid unnecessary fights.

name: Tapu Fini
description: Tapu Fini is both feared and revered for its power over water. Those who approach recklessly may suffer terrible calamities in its mysterious fog.

name: Cosmog
description: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

name: Cosmoem
description: Cosmoem absorbs dust and light while building energy inside its core. Though nearly motionless, its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

name: Solgaleo
description: Solgaleo’s body shines so brightly that night can look like midday. It was once known as the one that devours the sun.

name: Lunala
description: Light disappears wherever Lunala feeds, and night seems to spread across the day. Its third eye can open a path to another world.

name: Nihilego
description: Nihilego drifts like a jellyfish, trailing glowing tendrils behind it. It seeks out hosts to latch onto and feeds on their energy.

name: Buzzwole
description: With arms packed with muscle, Buzzwole can crack boulders with a single punch. It often flexes and displays its body to anyone nearby.

name: Pheromosa
description: Pheromosa refuses to touch anything in this world, as if it senses impurity everywhere. It can race across the land faster than most Pokémon.

name: Xurkitree
description: Its tall, wire-like body buzzes with electricity, and it can stand motionless for long stretches.

name: Celesteela
description: Like a metal rocket, Celesteela can launch itself by expelling gas from its arms. Its enormous body hides astonishing energy.

name: Kartana
description: Kartana is as thin as a sheet of paper, and its edges are sharper than any blade. It can cut through almost anything.

name: Guzzlord
description: Guzzlord has an insatiable hunger and an enormous mouth. It devours nearly everything it comes across, even mountains and buildings.

name: Necrozma
description: Light is both Necrozma’s source of energy and its obsession. When deprived of it, this mysterious Pokémon becomes increasingly violent.

name: Magearna
description: Magearna can sense and synchronize with the feelings of others. This ability helps it understand people and care for those who need it.

name: Marshadow
description: Marshadow can vanish into a shadow and quietly copy the movements of whoever casts it. The skills it borrows can eventually surpass the original.

name: Poipole
description: Poipole is a cheerful, mischievous Pokémon that cackles as it fires poison from the needles on its head.

name: Naganadel
description: Naganadel glides through the air and snipes its prey with jets of sticky venom from its needles.

name: Stakataka
description: Stakataka looks just like a wall of stacked stones. It stays perfectly still until something wanders too close, then springs to life.

name: Blacephalon
description: This playful, clown-like Pokémon explodes without warning. The blasts are always a surprise, and they distract opponents from what comes next.

name: Zeraora
description: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

name: Meltan
description: This small Pokémon eats metal and circulates liquid metal through its body to make energy. When the time comes, one Meltan can absorb its companions.

name: Melmetal
description: Melmetal swings its heavy hex-nut arms with tremendous force. The spinning motion adds power to its devastating punches.

name: Grookey
description: This playful Pokémon uses a special stick to make rhythmic beats. The sound carries energy that helps nearby flowers and plants thrive.

name: Thwackey
description: Thwackey earns respect by beating out fast rhythms with its two sticks. In battle, it can get so absorbed in drumming that it misses the finish.

name: Rillaboom
description: Rillaboom’s drumming draws power from a special tree stump whose roots obey its commands. The best drummer leads the troop and keeps the peace.

name: Scorbunny
description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
description: This Pokémon trains its footwork by kicking berries from tree branches and keeping them in the air. Its dense fur also protects it from cold.

name: Cinderace
description: Cinderace turns a pebble into a blazing soccer ball and fires powerful shots at foes. Cheers excite it, but showboating can leave it vulnerable.

name: Sobble
description: This timid Pokémon can camouflage itself when moisture changes its skin color. If fear takes over, its tears can leave anyone nearby weeping.

name: Drizzile
description: Drizzile is clever but lazy, defending its territory with traps. It can also form water balloons from moisture secreted by its palms.

name: Inteleon
description: Inteleon studies its surroundings with precision, spotting distant activity. It blasts foes’ weak points with jets of water from its fingertips.

name: Skwovet
description: Skwovet stuffs its cheeks with berries. Even a full patch never seems to satisfy its appetite.

name: Greedent
description: Greedent carries berries in its tail wherever it goes. The stash spills constantly, yet this dim-witted Pokémon rarely notices.

name: Rookidee
description: Rookidee faces opponents regardless of their size or strength. Its quick hops can disorient foes, and every battle helps it improve.

name: Corvisquire
description: Corvisquire is smart enough to pick up tools and use them in combat. Experience from many harsh battles helps it decide which opponents it can handle.

name: Corviknight
description: Few fliers command the air like Corviknight. Its polished armor and steady judgment make it a daunting sight.

name: Blipbug
description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
description: Dottler stays tucked inside its shell as it develops. It uses psychic powers to observe what happens outside and get ready for its next stage.

name: Orbeetle
description: Orbeetle emits psychic energy to study its surroundings from afar. Its large brain is proof of its remarkable intelligence.

name: Nickit
description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. Its tail brushes away clues before anyone spots the thief.

name: Thievul
description: Sharp claws and a nimble frame make Thievul a practiced food thief. It stalks its targets by following their scent.

name: Gossifleur
description: Gossifleur twirls in the wind while singing a cheerful song. Its charming display has inspired many people to raise one as a companion.

name: Eldegoss
description: Its cottony crown bears seeds rich in nutrients. Eldegoss scatters them on the wind to feed plants and Pokémon alike.

name: Wooloo
description: Falls barely trouble Wooloo. Its thick curls cushion the impact, and its wool makes sturdy fabric.

name: Dubwool
description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Chewtle
description: Anything within reach risks a bite from this teething Pokémon. Chewtle uses its sturdy horn to make an opening, then holds fast.

name: Drednaw
description: A retractable neck lets Drednaw strike from farther away than expected. Its powerful jaws can shear through steel.

name: Yamper
description: This gluttonous Pokémon only helps people with their work because it wants treats. Sparks of electricity fly off it as it runs.

name: Boltund
description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Rolycoly
description: Rolycoly zips across uneven ground like a tiny unicycle. Its body resembles coal, and burning coal keeps it moving.

name: Carkol
description: Carkol produces coal inside its body, leaving pieces for people to burn. It rolls swiftly, and its breath releases intensely hot flames.

name: Coalossal
description: Coalossal is calm until a mine is damaged. Then its blazing body can unleash heat fierce enough to incinerate intruders.

name: Applin
description: An apple is both Applin’s home and its disguise. The fruit’s flavor can shape what this little hidden Pokémon becomes.

name: Flapple
description: Flapple flies with wings made from apple skin and spits acid strong enough to burn. It can also reshape its body to resemble an ordinary apple.

name: Appletun
description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Silicobra
description: Silicobra blasts sand from its nostrils to blind enemies. While they’re distracted, it burrows underground and hides from danger.

name: Sandaconda
description: This Pokémon stores sand in a special sac and blasts it out by tightening its coils. If its supply runs out, Sandaconda becomes discouraged.

name: Cramorant
description: Cramorant can fell some opponents in one hit. Its hunger may make it swallow the wrong Pokémon when trying to catch prey whole.

name: Arrokuda
description: A flicker in the water sends Arrokuda surging forward. Its spear-like jaw leads the attack, but a full stomach slows it.

name: Barraskewda
description: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Despite its fearsome look, its flesh is said to taste surprisingly good.

name: Toxel
description: A touch from Toxel may leave skin tingling. Its poison-producing body also makes a small paralyzing charge.

name: Toxtricity
description: This irritable Pokémon drinks stagnant water to absorb toxins. Its guitar-like sounds come from clawing chest protrusions that produce electricity.

name: Sizzlipede
description: Yellow bands along Sizzlipede’s belly grow especially hot. It coils around prey and cooks it before taking a bite.

name: Centiskorch
description: When Centiskorch heats up, its body becomes dangerously hot. It can snap its long frame forward like a burning whip.

name: Clobbopus
description: This curious Pokémon explores by punching with its tentacles. It has the intelligence of a young child and searches for food on land.

name: Grapploct
description: Grapploct comes ashore to find opponents and test its grappling skills. Its muscular body and powerful tentacles make its holds difficult to escape.

name: Sinistea
description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Polteageist
description: Polteageist dwells in antique teapots, and authentic vessels are hard to find. Leftover black tea may attract one looking for a place to settle.

name: Hatenna
description: Hatenna senses feelings through the growth on its head. Strong emotions drive it away, so calm surroundings suit it best.

name: Hattrem
description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
description: Hatterene is highly sensitive to strong emotions and loud noises. It attacks with the claws on its long, hair-like tentacles when it’s startled.

name: Impidimp
description: The more annoyed everyone gets, the better Impidimp feels. It steals from homes and absorbs the frustration left behind.

name: Morgrem
description: A false show of surrender helps Morgrem lure opponents close. Then the sharp hair on its head becomes a sneaky weapon.

name: Grimmsnarl
description: Grimmsnarl’s shaggy hair is a source of power. It acts like muscle and can spread out to ensnare opponents.

name: Obstagoon
description: Obstagoon’s sudden roar can shake an opponent’s nerve. Its crossed-arm stance is a challenge meant to intimidate.

name: Perrserker
description: The iron helmet atop Perrserker’s head is made from hardened hair. After many battles, its claws can join together into deadly daggers.

name: Cursola
description: Ghostly matter surrounds Cursola’s soul. Anyone who touches its ectoplasm risks turning rigid as stone.

name: Sirfetch’d
description: This Pokémon blocks attacks with a sturdy leaf shield before striking with its sharp leek. It retires from battle when its beloved leek finally withers.

name: Mr. Rime
description: Crowds love Mr. Rime for its amusing dance steps and lively movements. It waves an icy cane in rhythm and channels psychic energy from its belly.

name: Runerigus
description: Runerigus is an ancient, slab-shaped Pokémon with a picture carved into its body. The picture shows the terrible memories it carries.

name: Milcery
description: Milcery is a small Pokémon whose creamy body comes from sweet-scented particles. Legend says any pastry shop it visits will prosper.

name: Alcremie
description: Alcremie’s cream changes flavor with its mood. When content, the cream it secretes becomes especially rich and sweet.

name: Falinks
description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Pincurchin
description: Pincurchin scrapes seaweed with its teeth while its spines store electricity. A broken spine can spark for three hours.

name: Snom
description: Snom eats snow to grow the icy spikes on its back. At rest, it ties itself to a branch and blends in like a dangling icicle.

name: Frosmoth
description: Frosmoth’s icy wings shed scales that drift down like snow over fields and mountains. It drives away those who damage nature by summoning blizzards.

name: Stonjourner
description: Sunset can hold Stonjourner’s attention for hours. Its powerful legs are also suited to delivering surprisingly dynamic kicks.

name: Eiscue
description: A frozen head helps Eiscue stay cool. When fishing, it lowers a lone hair into the water and waits for curious prey to approach.

name: Indeedee
description: Indeedee reads the emotions of those nearby with its horns. The more positive feelings it picks up, the stronger it becomes.

name: Morpeko
description: Roasted seeds are precious cargo to Morpeko. Eating them generates electricity, yet this small Pokémon soon feels hungry again.

name: Cufant
description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Dracozolt
description: Electricity surges from Dracozolt’s muscular tail, while its upper body seems small. It went extinct after exhausting its plant-based food supply.

name: Arctozolt
description: Arctozolt’s icy upper half trembles to create electricity, leaving it slow. This prehistoric Pokémon preserved food by freezing it against its body.

name: Dracovish
description: Powerful legs and jaws made Dracovish the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Arctovish
description: The skin on Arctovish’s face is nearly impervious to attacks, and it freezes prey with ease. Yet its awkward mouth placement made eating difficult.

name: Duraludon
description: Duraludon’s sleek metallic frame is surprisingly light. Rain is its weakness, since moisture can make its special metal rust.

name: Dreepy
description: Once a sea-dwelling Pokémon, Dreepy returned as a ghost. It’s weak on its own, yet training alongside friends helps it develop.

name: Drakloak
description: Drakloak dotes on the Dreepy it carries. If none is around, it grows uneasy and may treat another Pokémon as a stand-in.

name: Dragapult
description: Dragapult hides Dreepy inside the openings of its horns when it isn’t battling. Once a fight begins, it launches them like supersonic missiles.

name: Zacian
description: Quick and fierce, this wolf-like Pokémon fights with a blade held in its jaws. Few foes can keep up with its speed.

name: Zamazenta
description: Metal gathers across Zamazenta’s body, hardening its defense. It meets incoming force head-on rather than yielding ground.

name: Eternatus
description: Eternatus was found inside a meteorite that fell to Earth 20,000 years ago. Its presence appears to affect the energy that surrounds living things.

name: Kubfu
description: Kubfu perfects its martial arts through training. Pulling its white head hair makes its fighting spirit surge.

name: Urshifu
description: The mountain-dwelling Urshifu sharpens its techniques by running over dangerous cliffs. It believes one hardened-fist strike can decide a battle.

name: Zarude
description: Zarude lives in dense forests with a pack of its own kind and is feared by other Pokémon. When its vines shed, they nourish the forest soil.

name: Regieleki
description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash its latent power.

name: Regidrago
description: Regidrago’s body is made from crystallized dragon energy. Its full power remains difficult to measure.

name: Glastrier
description: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Spectrier
description: Spectrier races through the night, drawing the life force from sleeping Pokémon. It prefers silence and solitude.

name: Calyrex
description: Calyrex is a legendary king known for mercy and healing. Stories say its presence can soothe sorrow and awaken plants that have long lain dormant.

name: Wyrdeer
description: When Wyrdeer raises its body, dark antler orbs shine as barriers appear. Its beard fur is prized for making warm winter clothes.

name: Kleavor
description: Few trees withstand Kleavor’s stone axes. This volatile Pokémon also uses its rock-hard body as a shield.

name: Ursaluna
description: Ursaluna’s powerful body suits its marshy habitat. It can manipulate peat to gain an advantage.

name: Basculegion
description: Basculegion carries the souls of fallen companions. Their unfinished journey upstream gives it strength.

name: Sneasler
description: Sneasler dominates the frozen heights with powerful attacks and virulent poison. Unlike many species, it prefers living and hunting alone.

name: Overqwil
description: Overqwil’s long spikes resemble a sea mine. It gulps down poison to nourish its body.

name: Enamorus
description: Enamorus crosses the sea as winter fades. Its legendary affection is said to coax fresh buds from bare branches.

name: Sprigatito
description: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when Sprigatito is in the sun.

name: Floragato
description: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on its mood. When it’s prepared to battle, the fur becomes pointed and needle-sharp.

name: Meowscarada
description: Misdirection is Meowscarada’s specialty. It plants a pollen bomb while foes admire its illusion.

name: Fuecoco
description: Warm rocks are Fuecoco’s favorite place to lounge. Its small flame sac leaks spare fire energy from the dent atop its head.

name: Crocalor
description: Crocalor’s head carries an egg-shaped fireball born from its abundant energy. When it gives a guttural cry, flames burst out in all directions.

name: Skeledirge
description: When Skeledirge sings, the fiery bird above its snout dances and changes shape. Its gentle notes soothe, while flames scorch foes.

name: Quaxly
description: With powerful legs, Quaxly can navigate swift rivers without trouble. It carefully grooms its grime-resistant feathers and often worries over details.

name: Quaxwell
description: Quaxwell trains its legs in shallow water and competes in graceful kicks. It studies people and Pokémon to add new moves to its dances.

name: Quaquaval
description: Quaquaval’s energetic dance captivates crowds as its water-feather plumes slash foes. Its powerful legs can kick hard enough to move a truck.

name: Lechonk
description: Lechonk prefers only the finest food. Its herbal scent repels bug Pokémon, though its sharp nose is mainly used for foraging.

name: Oinkologne
description: A fine, shiny coat is a point of pride for Oinkologne. It emits a powerful, sweet aroma that can entrance female Pokémon nearby.

name: Tarountula
description: Tarountula wraps itself in a springy ball of thread. Its fibers can deflect sharp blades.

name: Spidops
description: Spidops lays sticky threads across its territory to trap intruders. It clings to branches and ceilings, moving silently before striking prey.

name: Nymble
description: A folded third set of legs gives Nymble a surprising burst of jumping power. It uses nimble leaps to avoid incoming blows while attacking its foe.

name: Lokix
description: When pushed to its limits, Lokix unfolds its third pair of legs to attack. The strain keeps it from holding this stance for long.

name: Pawmi
description: Pawmi rubs its cheek sacs to make electricity. Its forepaw pads release jolts, even as it wobbles upright.

name: Pawmo
description: Quick punches and sudden shocks make Pawmo fierce in a fight. Its forepaws strike as the pads discharge electricity.

name: Pawmot
description: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Tandemaus
description: Tandemaus work together to gather useful nesting materials, cutting pieces with their incisors. Whatever food they find, they split exactly in half.

name: Maushold
description: Maushold’s tiny family keeps close, sharing the same space and purpose. In a serious fight, every member joins the defense.

name: Fidough
description: Fidough feels smooth and moist, with yeast in its breath that starts fermentation nearby. People have long valued it for cooking.

name: Dachsbun
description: The aroma from Dachsbun’s body can help wheat thrive. When exposed to strong heat, its skin hardens into a protective surface.

name: Smoliv
description: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Dolliv
description: The oil Dolliv produces is tasty and fresh-scented, and it willingly shares it. When its head fruit ripens, it ventures away from people.

name: Arboliva
description: Calm and caring, Arboliva offers its nourishing oil to Pokémon in need. Against threats, it fires aromatic oil with boulder-breaking force.

name: Squawkabilly
description: Squawkabilly flocks sort themselves by feather color and fight over territory. Green-feathered groups are dominant and noisy at feeding times.

name: Nacli
description: Nacli leaves a salty trail as it moves. Its body constantly replenishes the rock salt scraped from it.

name: Naclstack
description: Naclstack compresses salt inside its body and fires hardened pellets that can pierce iron sheets. It can also dry-cure prey with salt spray.

name: Garganacl
description: Garganacl sprinkles healing salt on injured Pokémon. Others gather to lick the minerals on its body.

name: Charcadet
description: Charcadet was born when burnt charcoal came to life. Its fiery fighting spirit drives it to challenge even powerful opponents.

name: Armarouge
description: Armarouge’s armor belonged to a celebrated warrior, and its loyalty runs deep. The fortified suit lets it unleash fierce fireballs.

name: Ceruledge
description: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

name: Tadbulb
description: Tadbulb wags its tail to generate electricity. Its blinking head warns nearby allies of danger.

name: Bellibolt
description: A belly-button dynamo powers Bellibolt as its body expands and contracts. Its apparent eyes are decoys.

name: Wattrel
description: Wind rushing through Wattrel’s wings creates electricity in its bones. It shocks prey during sea dives.

name: Kilowattrel
description: Kilowattrel stores wing-made electricity in its throat sac. It inflates the sac to amplify its charge, but its feathers make it a poor swimmer.

name: Maschiff
description: Maschiff tries to look intimidating by scowling, but its face can make crying children laugh. Its strong jaws and thick fat aid defense.

name: Mabosstiff
description: Rugged and strong, this large Pokémon protects its pack. Its loud bark scares off most challengers.

name: Shroodle
description: Shroodle marks its territory with foul-smelling poison. If angered, its venomous bite can leave intruders paralyzed.

name: Grafaiai
description: Grafaiai paints patterns on forest trees with saliva-covered fingers. Each one repeats its own design throughout life.

name: Bramblin
description: A soul unable to pass on became Bramblin after wind tangled it in dried grass. It rolls wherever the breeze takes it, but strongly dislikes water.

name: Brambleghast
description: Brambleghast wander around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Toedscool
description: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

name: Toedscruel
description: Toedscruel gathers with others in deep forests and dislikes strangers. It wraps its ten tentacles around prey to drain nutrients, causing pain.

name: Klawf
description: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Capsakid
description: Small but fiery, Capsakid grows spicier the longer it basks in sunlight. Some traditional dishes use its shed front teeth as a heat-packed ingredient.

name: Scovillain
description: Spicy chemicals stimulate the brain in its green head, making it vicious. When Scovillain rampages, nothing can stop it.

name: Rellor
description: Rellor cherishes a mud ball made from sand, dirt, and psychic energy. It rolls the ball while preparing to evolve.

name: Rabsca
description: Rabsca rolls its ball gently to keep the infant inside asleep. Its body scarcely moves, leading some to believe its true form lives within.

name: Flittle
description: Flittle’s feet barely touch the ground, held up by psychic power. It fiercely pursues anyone who steals its berries.

name: Espathra
description: Espathra immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: Tinkatink
description: Tinkatink collects scraps of metal to make a hammer. The little smith keeps working even when its creations are stolen.

name: Tinkatuff
description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: Wiglett
description: Wiglett resembles Diglett but is a different species. It hides beneath the sand when startled.

name: Wugtrio
description: Wugtrio lives in wet sand. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament and drags victims into its den.

name: Bombirdier
description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Finizen
description: A sticky fluid helps Finizen keep its seawater tail ring together. It can sense emotions with ultrasonic waves.

name: Palafin
description: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: Varoom
description: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
description: Revavroom detonates gas made from poison and minerals in its eight cylinders. Its exhaust roar warns others away.

name: Cyclizar
description: People have ridden Cyclizar for thousands of years, relying on its speed. Its warm body and smooth movements make it well suited to carrying riders.

name: Orthworm
description: Orthworm tunnels into mountains to find something to eat. Its sturdy, segmented body is so tough that collapsing rock barely troubles it.

name: Glimmet
description: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. It scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
description: Glimmora’s crystalline petals are formed from poison energy, giving it a jewel-like appearance. It can fire powerful beams from its cone-shaped body.

name: Greavard
description: Greavard is a friendly ghost that hates being alone. Anyone who’s kind to it will find it trotting along behind them.

name: Houndstone
description: Houndstone spends much of its time sleeping in graveyards and is deeply loyal to its master. It was reborn after receiving loving mourning.

name: Flamigo
description: Flamigo stores energy in its belly and keeps it from escaping through its beak. Flocks can attack in perfect synchrony.

name: Cetoddle
description: Cetoddle roams frigid regions in small groups. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
description: Ice energy makes Cetitan’s upper-jaw horn cold enough to freeze its surroundings. Strong muscles and thick fat protect its body.

name: Veluza
description: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Dondozo
description: Dondozo is powerful but not very clever. It follows Tatsugiri as though the smaller Pokémon were its boss.

name: Tatsugiri
description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Annihilape
description: Annihilape gained power beyond its physical limits when its anger peaked. It channels hidden rage through fists that can shatter foes.

name: Clodsire
description: Calm and quiet, it spends hours resting in mud. If something bothers it, poisonous spines shoot out from its back.

name: Farigiraf
description: Farigiraf’s tail-head has hardened to shield its main head. Its synchronized brains greatly boost its psychic power and combat ability.

name: Dudunsparce
description: Dudunsparce digs long underground nests through bedrock with its hard tail. It can fill its narrow lungs with air and blast intruders away.

name: Kingambit
description: Kingambit leads a massive army into battle, though elaborate strategies aren’t its strength. It keeps advancing through sheer power and force.

name: Great Tusk
description: Great Tusk is a hulking Pokémon with two enormous tusks. It charges headlong at anything in its way and is hard to stop once it gets going.

name: Scream Tail
description: This small, pink Pokémon bounces around energetically. It lets out loud, ringing screeches when it’s excited.

name: Brute Bonnet
description: Its broad, bonnet-like cap hides a body full of toxic spores. Anything that approaches its patch of forest gets a rough welcome.

name: Flutter Mane
description: Mysterious and mischievous, Flutter Mane appears at night and seems to enjoy frightening anyone who spots its pale glow.

name: Slither Wing
description: This burly, insect-like Pokémon has a thick coat of fur. It moves with a low, sliding gait and strikes with brutal strength.

name: Sandy Shocks
description: Metal rods jut from Sandy Shocks in a bristling cluster. Its strange outline gives every movement an uncanny feel.

name: Iron Treads
description: Iron Treads rolls across the ground like a wheel, and its spiked, metallic body can crush rocks as it goes.

name: Iron Bundle
description: Iron Bundle is a small, round, machine-like Pokémon that fires streams of freezing water at its targets.

name: Iron Hands
description: This powerful, humanoid Pokémon has a mighty grip. It battles using sheer strength, and a surge of electricity runs through its arms.

name: Iron Jugulis
description: Iron Jugulis has multiple heads and hovers above the ground, firing dark energy from each mouth.

name: Iron Moth
description: Shimmering plates form Iron Moth’s wings as it glides. Its sleek metallic body moves with eerie, mechanical precision.

name: Iron Thorns
description: Iron Thorns is a hulking, spiky Pokémon with electricity sparking across its body. It stomps through the countryside, leaving deep footprints.

name: Frigibax
description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
description: Arctibax turns its dorsal fin into a sharp blade of ice. It flips through the air to slash opponents with the fin.

name: Baxcalibur
description: The cryogenic breath of Baxcalibur can freeze even liquid-hot lava. It launches itself into combat upside down and attacks with its dorsal blade.

name: Gimmighoul
description: This tiny, ghostly Pokémon lurks in a treasure chest. It drains the life force of anyone who tries to steal its riches.

name: Gholdengo
description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Wo-Chien
description: Wo-Chien formed from a punished person’s grudge and dead leaves. It drains plant life, leaving forests withered and fields barren.

name: Chien-Pao
description: Chien-Pao carries the hatred of sword victims in a body of snow. It controls huge snow masses and plays in avalanches it creates.

name: Ting-Lu
description: Ting-Lu formed from fear poured into an ancient vessel. Rocks and dirt now cover its body.

name: Chi-Yu
description: Chi-Yu formed from envy held in curved beads. It swims through lava created by its own flames.

name: Roaring Moon
description: Its fierce roar echoes across the night sky, and it attacks with little regard for anything that gets in its way.

name: Iron Valiant
description: Sleek and swift, this armored Pokémon seems built for dueling, and its glowing blades cut cleanly through almost anything.

name: Koraidon
description: Koraidon has a powerful body built for sprinting and fighting, and it charges at opponents with astonishing speed and strength.

name: Miraidon
description: Miraidon races along the ground with electricity trailing behind. Its sleek body resembles a futuristic dragon.

name: Walking Wake
description: An imposing crest arches over Walking Wake’s head, lending its silhouette fierce elegance. It charges ahead with restless power.

name: Iron Leaves
description: This forest-green, mechanical Pokémon is as precise as a swordsman. It uses its mind to move objects without touching them.

name: Dipplin
description: An uncommon apple can bring two little wyrms together as Dipplin. They share the fruit and work in tandem, head to tail.

name: Poltchageist
description: Poltchageist is a ghostly little Pokémon with a leafy, tea-green look. It passes for a Sinistea at a glance, but the two have nothing in common.

name: Sinistcha
description: Sinistcha pretends to be tea, then drains a drinker’s life force. It hides in cool, dark corners.

name: Okidogi
description: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Munkidori
description: This crafty Pokémon mixes poison with mind powers. It likes to confuse its foes before striking.

name: Fezandipiti
description: Fezandipiti captivates people. The toxic substances from its chain are said to enhance its looks and voice.

name: Ogerpon
description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the power contained in its masks.

name: Archaludon
description: Archaludon can shrug off a cave-in and dig rocky slopes for food. Static electricity powers the beams it fires on all fours.

name: Hydrapple
description: The central syrpent commands the six others inside Hydrapple’s syrup apple. When their moods align, the group unleashes its full power.

name: Gouging Fire
description: This raging, flame-wreathed Pokémon has an ancient look. It’s rarely calm and always ready to fight.

name: Raging Bolt
description: Raging Bolt is hot-tempered and ancient in appearance, and the electricity it gives off makes the air itself hum.

name: Iron Boulder
description: Hard edges give Iron Boulder the look of a machine modeled on a powerful beast. Its mechanical features look built for impact.

name: Iron Crown
description: A crown of shining blades gives Iron Crown a regal but dangerous look. It moves like a living weapon.

name: Terapagos
description: Terapagos turns energy into hard crystals for protection. It’s believed to be the source of a strange crystallizing phenomenon.

name: Pecharunt
description: Inside Pecharunt’s peach-shaped shell lies potent poison. Its toxic mochi can twist appetites and abilities into obedience.
